articleTitle: Guided-TargetTree-Hybrid_A* Path Planning Algorithm for Vertical Parking
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: To enhance the safety of automatic parking in complex environments and reduce the time consumption of path searching, a vertical parking path planning method based on the optimization of Hybrid A* is proposed. Firstly, a costmap containing semantic information is generated to produce a Voronoi diagram. The starting point and the target point of the vehicle are projected onto the Voronoi map, and an A* search is used to create a global guiding line for the Hybrid A* algorithm. Simultaneously, a target tree is generated from the parking space to extend the target point for the Hybrid A*. The Hybrid A* is then optimized to search for a parking path that satisfies the vehicle's kinematics, and an SQP method is used for smoothing. Through real vehicle verification, this method meets the parking requirements in narrow spaces, demonstrating strong adaptability and feasibility.

articleTitle: Aerial Object Detection in Complex Scenes Based on Mask Guidance*
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Object detection in aerial imagery presents distinct challenges compared to general object detection, notably false alarm interference. While general object detection methods primarily address scale variation in natural scenes, they often neglect two critical issues prevalent in large-area earth observation scenes. In this letter, we introduce a two-stage object detection approach, denoted as MG2ADet (Mask Guidance and Additive Angular Margin Loss). MG2ADet features a streamlined design yet achieves competitive performance. To enhance object feature discrimination and mitigate background noise interference, we incorporate a mask guidance module into the feature pyramid. This module directs network features towards the foreground area using pseudo mask labels. Additionally, the additive angular margin loss normalizes the original classification loss to cosine loss and introduces an angular margin penalty in the cosine angle space. This helps minimize intra-class distance and augment inter-class distance. Rigorous experiments conducted on public remote sensing datasets underscore the superior detection performance of our algorithm compared to numerous existing detectors, encompassing both one-stage and two-stage detectors.

articleTitle: A Non-Dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm with Adaptive Genetic Operator: NSGA-AGO
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Unlike single objective optimization algorithm, solving multi-objective problem (MOP) is a complex task. The solution of a multi-objective optimization problem is a set of solutions, called the Pareto-optimal solution set. Multi-objective Optimization Genetic Algorithm (MOGA) is a commonly used evolutionary computation method for solving multi-objective optimization problems. Genetic algorithm has good global search ability in solving nonlinear, global, and other problems, while also possessing advantages such as distributed computing. However, the local optimization ability of genetic algorithm is poor, and there is a problem of getting stuck in the local optimal solution leading to premature convergence. At the same time, the search ability of genetic algorithm is significantly reduced in the later stage of evolution. To solve the above two issues, this paper introduces the adaptive genetic operator and proposes the Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm with Adaptive Genetic Operator (NSGA-AGO). According to the distribution characteristics of population fitness during the evolution process of genetic algorithms, the crossover and mutation probabilities of individuals in the population can be adaptively adjusted to maintain population diversity and improve the convergence ability of the algorithm. The experimental results show that the improved algorithm improves the convergence speed of the optimization process, reduces the standard deviation of convergence indicators, and has high stability.

articleTitle: Enhancing Ionospheric Radar Returns Classification with Feature Engineering-Based Light Gradient Boosting Machine Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In ionospheric research, the distinction between relevant and irrelevant radar echoes is pivotal. Utilizing beneficial echoes for further analysis while disregarding irrelevant ones. Traditional manual analysis methods, being time-consuming and error-prone, have paved the way for the adoption of machine learning methods as a more efficient alternative. This paper introduces a Feature Engineering-based Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LGBM) algorithm designed for the classification of ionospheric radar echoes. The incorporation of advanced features, unearthed through feature engineering, brings a novel interpretive perspective and methodology to comprehend the dataset. The classification process employs the LGBM algorithm. The results obtained through this approach showcase a remarkable accuracy of 97.30% and an F1-score of 97.7%, highlighting outstanding performance in ionospheric radar returns classification.

articleTitle: DiffST: High-Level Style Feature Transfer Via Diffusion Models
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Image style transfer aims to transfer the style of one image to another to create a new image with a specific artistic style. Existing style transfer algorithms primarily focus on transferring low-level features, such as textures, colors, strokes, etc., while neglecting the transfer of high-level features like semantic elements and object shapes. To address this issue, we propose DiffST, a new style transfer architecture based on pretrained text-to-image diffusion models. Specifically, DiffST can fully extract the feature of the style images to guide the redrawing of the content image, thereby completing the style transfer. Moreover, DiffST introduces a new image redrawing method called two-stage inversion, which effectively preserves the information of the content image and enhances the quality of the generated image. We demonstrate the quality of our transfer using numerous different paintings and compare DiffST with state-of-the-art methods, proving the superiority of DiffST.

articleTitle: Enhancing Real-World Facial Expression Recognition: A Deep Learning Approach based on Attention Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Occlusion and pose variation are the biggest interference factors in real-world face expression recognition (FER). Faces are likely to be occluded by items such as sunglasses, ducktails, and scarves, which can significantly change the visual appearance of the face, while varied poses can lead to partial information loss and inaccurate localization. In this paper, we propose a new deep learning network model for facial expression recognition, firstly, an attention mechanism module is added on top of the residual neural network, which includes spatial and channel attention modules for suppressing unimportant feature information and highlight the key information. Second, a regional attention mechanism is added for adaptively extracting feature vectors from localized unobstructed facial regions, which are combined with global feature information to learn more comprehensive and detailed potential key information. The proposed method achieved good results on two facial expression datasets, FER2013 and RAF-DB, obtaining an accuracy of 74.37 and 89.12, respectively.

articleTitle: A High Precision Low-Rank Tensor Recovery Method Based on Balanced Tensor and Non-Convex Function
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The most classical low-rank tensor recovery method which depends on the minimization of the sum of the nuclear norms has been widely used in many fields. While, the results are not that satisfactory in some specific scenarios, such as color video recovery, especially when the number of observed values is small. One of the root causes lies in the unbalanced structure of the tensor, in which the dim sizes of the third mode is much smaller than others, and this will lead to an extremely unbalanced and actually full rank unfolding matrix. Another important reason is the convex substitution of rank, and recent researches demonstrate that some non-convex functions could achieve better results in accuracy. To address the problem, this paper reconstructs a more balanced tensor through a reshaping operator, which retains the low rank property. Furthermore, a non-convex function is taken into tensor recovery. Finally, experiments on color videos are carried out to validate the effective of the method.

articleTitle: Research on Water Leakage Fault Detection of Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Plant Room Based on Computer Vision Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Air conditioning and refrigeration plant rooms have always been at risk of equipment damage and energy wastage due to water leakage faults. At present, only manual methods of water leakage fault detection, especially in the dark light environment, are obviously unable to avoid the potential risks. In this paper, we propose an improved algorithm YOLO-SEE (SENet+EIOU) based on computer vision technology to identify water leakage faults in potential leakage areas of air conditioning and refrigeration plant rooms under different lighting environments to reduce the risk of subsequent damage caused by faults. The self-made water leakage dataset of refrigeration plant rooms has 2485 images, the attention mechanism SENet is inserted into the backbone part of the model to improve the feature extraction ability of the model, the loss function EIOU is improved to increase the convergence speed of the model and provide better location results, and the performance of the algorithm is validated by comparing the algorithms such as SSD, YOLOv5s and etc. on the test set. The experimental results show that the improved YOLO-SEE algorithm achieves an average precision of 88.9% for water leakage detection in air-conditioning and refrigeration plant rooms, and still ensures the accuracy and real-time performance under different lighting environments, which can meet the needs of real-time monitoring of water leakage faults in actual refrigeration plant rooms.

articleTitle: Design of Efficient Rectifier Circuit for Electromagnetic Energy Harvesting Under Low Input Power Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper presents a structurally simple rectifier design for harvesting electromagnetic (EM) energy in extremely low microwave (MW) power density environments. The low forward voltage Schottky diode SMS7630 is used as the key rectifier component. A simple impedance matching network is designed using Smith Chart specifically for working at −20 dBm input power level. The measurement results show that when the input MW power is −20 dBm and the direct-current (DC) load is 4 kΩ, the proposed rectifier circuit can achieve a MW-DC conversion efficiency of 21.6% at 2.45 GHz. It even can output a net positive DC voltage at extremely low input power of −36 dBm. The proposed rectifier can be easily integrated with efficient flexible antennas to drive low-power wearable sensors.

articleTitle: A DSP-Based Compensation System for Residual Field Suppression Within a Magnetically Shielded Cylinder
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: To achieve ultra-high sensitivity measurement of the optically-pumped magnetometer (OPM), the ambient magnetic field should be well suppressed to construct a near zero-field environment. In this paper, a DSP-based active compensation system has been developed to improve the shielding performance of the magnetically shielded cylinder (MSC). Meanwhile, we introduce the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm to obtain the optimal PID gains. The experimental results show the PSO-PID method has better compensation performance than the classical PID method. In the time domain, the DC component and fluctuation of the residual field can be suppressed to 0 pT and 5.9 pT, respectively, which indicates the feasibility of our active compensation system.

articleTitle: TransRT-RMP: An Rotation Translation and Relationship Mapping Attribute-Based Representation Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Knowledge reasoning, knowledge question re-sponding, and knowledge retrieval have all benefited from existing knowledge representation learning models. They are, never-theless, insufficient when dealing with complex relationships. As a result, this study introduces TransRT-Rmp,a knowledge representation learning model based on rotation translation and relationship mapping features. To begin, relationships and entities are embedded in low-dimensional vector spaces using hyperplane projection. Second, the translation rules have been improved by including rotation translation rules, which eliminates the typical constraint of head entity+relationship=tail entity. Then, relation-ship mapping features were added to improve the model's capac-ity to handle complex relationships. The quality of producing negative example triplets can be enhanced during model training by replacing semantically related things, which increases sample diversity and improves the model's generalization ability and robustness. Finally, results from experiments on publicly available datasets FB15K,WN18, WN11, and FB13 show that our technique performs well in MeanRank Hits@10 In terms of ACC indicators, the most positive outcomes were obtained.

articleTitle: Cluster Dependency and Synchronization in Multilayer Directed Complex Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper makes an important contribution to solving the computational complexity problem of cluster dependence research in multilayer directed networks. In previous studies, the relationship between cluster partitioning and cluster dependency detection in multilayer complex networks has been studied, but the process is complicated and the computational complexity is too high. In order to overcome this challenge, the correlation analysis method of network quotient graph is proposed in this paper. By considering the relationships and interactions between clusters at a higher level of abstraction, this analysis allows for the immediate detection of dependencies without the need for extensive computation on the original network. Firstly, we propose a method of cluster partitioning, which is used to classify multilayer complex networks. The corresponding quotient graph is obtained according to the construction method of quotient graph proposed by us. In the dimension of quotient graph, we detect the dependencies between clusters. Finally, we provide a detailed simulation example to validate our findings.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Gearbox Oil Temperature Early Warning Platform System for Wind Turbine Units
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Addressing the challenges of integrating, transmitting, and sharing multi-source heterogeneous data generated during the operation of wind turbine units, this study analyzes the real-time operational data provided by the wind turbine SCADA system. Combined with data from other systems within the wind farm and historical data, it proposes unified platform management for data and establishes a Data Warning Supervision Center platform. This facilitates data integration and sharing within the wind farm, providing data support for real-time online warning analysis. The goal is to reduce equipment maintenance costs, enhance the economic performance of the wind farm, and assist maintenance personnel. Additionally, integrating the gearbox oil temperature early warning method for wind turbine units, a wind turbine unit early warning platform is designed and developed, combined with wind farm operations and maintenance management, along with simulation analysis. Through a case study of the gearbox oil temperature warning module, the specific application process of this solution is presented, demonstrating its effectiveness based on usage.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning Recommendation Method based on Deep Interest Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the rapid development of MOOC platforms, course recommendation has become a focal point in the research field of recommendations. Effectively modeling user preferences is a crucial task within this context. Despite the notable achievements of reinforcement learning methods in simulating user preferences, there are still existing issues with current approaches. This paper introduces a hierarchical reinforcement learning method based on deep interest networks. By incorporating an adaptive weighting unit to represent the correlation between the current course and historical courses, the method aims to better simulate user preferences. Experimental results on two real datasets demonstrate the superiority of our approach over baseline methods, and it exhibits strong generalization in other recommendation domains.

articleTitle: A Flight Platform Design that Supports Multiple Batches of Components
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the rapid development of commercial aerospace, by formulating a selection scheme of components that is suitable for task demand to shorten the development cycle of spacecraft and reduce development costs as an effective way to get market competitiveness in commercial spacecraft. The flight test of components is one of the effective means to verify the aerospace applicability of components. In this paper, a flight test platform scheme that supports the in-orbit testing of multiple batches of components is proposed. The test platform consists of two parts: a support system and a test system. The support system includes a central management control module and a power supply module, and the test system includes an exposure test module and a non-exposure test module. the support system is responsible for providing stable and reliable power supply, telemetry, remote control, data transmission resources for the test system, as well as health detection and management of the test system; The test system is responsible for providing a mechanical interface for on-orbit replacement of the test project to facilitate on-orbit operation. The article introduces the two systems in detail from three parts: overall scheme, electronic design and structural design. This scheme has a high reference value for the design of component flight tests.

articleTitle: Measurement of High-Temperature Delay Performance Degradation in FPGA Based on Distributed Temperature Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The rapid development of thermal issues in Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs) has significantly affected the delay performance of these devices, necessitating in-depth study. Ring oscillators, commonly employed as digital temperature sensors in FPGAs, offer a means to sense thermal effects. In this paper, we focus on measuring and studying the delay performance degradation of Xilinx Zynq-7 series FPGAs, based on a 28nm process, when subjected to long-term high temperature working environments. We utilize the internal logic resources of the FPGA to create an embedded ring oscillator, which acts as a temperature sensor. A temperature sensing network is then established to collect frequency data. The degradation of the output frequency of the ring oscillator serves to characterize the delay performance degradation of the FPGA under long-term high temperature operation. After subjecting three target devices to continuous high-temperature degradation experiments for 514 hours, the results highlight that the majority of the ring oscillators exhibit approximately 1% frequency degradation. Moreover, some instances of more pronounced and irreversible degradation were observed. Finally, we briefly analyze the failure mechanism. This experiment provides a theoretical method and experimental support for the study of the thermal characteristics of domestically produced FPGAs.

articleTitle: Ship Target Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In view of the low accuracy and low efficiency of traditional ship target detection methods, this paper introduces an improved ship target detection method based on YOLOv5. Firstly, we preprocess the ship target data set, which includes graph denoising, graph enhancement and so on. Secondly, based on the benchmark YOLOv5 object detection algorithm, SimAM attention mechanism module is introduced. Then, a pyramid feature fusion strategy is added to filter conflicting information in airspace to suppress inconsistent features and improve the network's feature fusion capability for targets of different scales. Finally, the trained model is tested to achieve accurate evaluation of ship target detection. Experimental results show that the proposed ship target detection method is compared with YOLOv5s in accuracy rate, recall rate, mAP@0.5 and mAP@0.5: 0.95 increased by 1.9, 3.8, 2.6 and 7.3 percentage points. Respectively, which can meet the requirements of detection speed and obtain better detection accuracy, effectively realizing high-speed and high-precision ship detection.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Unmanned Vehicle Autonomous Navigation System Based on Binocular Camera
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Aiming at the navigation problem of unmanned vehicles in extreme environments such as communication interference and limited GPS signals, this study proposes an autonomous navigation method based on binocular cameras. The method enables the unmanned vehicle to complete the task of localization and map building using only binocular images, without the need for other sensors or signal sources. Meanwhile, this study also proposes a local path planning obstacle avoidance method based on depth map, which, when combined with global localization information, can take into account both local obstacle avoidance and global path navigation, and can cope with random environmental changes. The system uses a single sensor for autonomous obstacle avoidance and navigation, which reduces the computational requirements and ensures the low cost of the navigation system. In order to verify the reliability and effectiveness of the system under signal-constrained conditions, the system is evaluated in a simulation environment and a real field scenario, respectively. The experimental results show that the system is able to achieve reliable localization and path planning under signal-constrained conditions.

articleTitle: Phase Coding Optimization Based on OTFS Waveform in Multi-User Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The introduction of OTFS technology presents significant advantages for 6G communication, leveraging its time-frequency orthogonality for robust adaptability in complex multipath environments. This waveform also demonstrates its feasibility with radar detection. In scenarios involving multiple user access, high-precision target detection can be achieved through the segmentation and interleaved allocation in the delay-Doppler domain. However, unoptimized OTFS modulation waveforms exhibit elevated sidelobes, resulting in a degradation of the target detection performance. In this paper, an optimization method based on iteratively global exploration and local spiral refinement is designed for the phase coding in the delay-Doppler plane of the OTFS waveform. Element-wise updating is executed during the spiral refinement for the multidimensional phase encoding value. Simulation results confirms that the proposed method for OTFS waveform in radar applications exhibits excellent sidelobe suppression performance compared with traditional optimization.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Detection Foreign Objects in Transmission Lines based on Few-shot learning from UAV Remote Sensing Images
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Timely detection of foreign objects on power transmission lines is essential for improving the safety of the power system. To address the challenge of a limited number of samples for foreign objects on power transmission lines, this paper proposes a few-shot learning-based algorithm for detecting power transmission line foreign objects in unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing images based on the Faster RCNN network. Firstly, a Dual-Awareness Attention Mechanism (DAAM) is employed to capture the spatial relationships between support feature and query feature. Subsequently, a Representation Decoupling Mechanism (RDM) is utilized to address the data distribution differences between base classes and novel classes. Finally, the model is validated on a dataset of foreign objects on power transmission lines. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method effectively detects foreign objects on power transmission lines, providing a novel approach for few-shot learning in the detection of foreign objects on power transmission lines.

Author Keywords: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Remote Sensing Images

articleTitle: Multi-Robot Multi-Objective Path Planning Based on Improved DWA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In order to solve problems of DWA (Dynamic-Window Approach) in path planning, such as easily trapping into local optimal solutions, fixing evaluation function coefficients and using a single obstacle avoidance strategy for multi-robots under multi-objective environments, a novel FA-DWA (Fast Adaptive-Dynamic Window Approach) algorithm is proposed. In this new FA-DWA algorithm, three mainly aspects are considered. Firstly, based on the distance between the mobile robot and the obstacle, the evaluation function of DWA can be dynamically adjusted to improve the adaptability. Secondly, based on a deflection angle assigned to the low-priority robot, an encounter coordination strategy is used to avoid collision problems for multi-robots. Thirdly, the F-RRT* algorithm is used to obtain the global path to avoid falling into the local optimal. Finally, some simulation experiments are given to prove the validity and effectiveness of the improved algorithms.

articleTitle: A Multiscale MixFormer Network for Computer-Aided Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Deep learning has been widely utilized in medical-assisted detection and diagnosis. In the classification and diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease (AD), deep learning can combine low-level features into more abstract high-level representations to aid disease detection. In this paper, we propose a model architecture based on a Multiscale MixFormer. This architecture incorporates local window self-attention mechanisms with a multi-scale convolutional structure, enabling bidirectional interconnections across channels and spatial dimensions. This addresses the issues of limited receptive fields and inadequate modeling capabilities of standard local window self-attention models. In classification experiments between AD and normal controls (NC), AD and mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and MCI and NC, the model achieved accuracies of 95.09%, 93.58%, and 94.47% respectively. In a three-category experiment for AD, MCI, and NC, the 89.63% classification accuracy achieved outperforms related studies for these diagnostic groups. Our research provides an effective deep learning solution for the computer-aided diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Industrial Real-Time Ethernet Redundant Network Based on Parallel Redundancy Protocol
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Industrial real-time Ethernet technology is widely used in modern industrial control systems due to its high communication rate and low application cost. However, in complex network environments, industrial real-time Ethernet may encounter data collisions, data loss, and other issues, which reduce the overall reliability of industrial control systems. To address these issues, a method for designing and implementing industrial real-time Ethernet redundancy networks based on parallel redundancy protocols is proposed. The method first analyzes the redundant data frame structure, dual-connected node (DANP) structure, and redundancy implementation principle of parallel redundancy protocols (PRP). Then, aiming at the standard redundancy discard algorithm principle and its shortcomings, an improved sliding window redundancy discard algorithm is proposed to adapt to complex network environments. Based on the discard algorithm, dual-connected redundancy nodes are designed and implemented. Finally, the dual-connected redundancy nodes are used as the core to construct industrial real-time Ethernet redundancy networks. The test results show that in a PRP-based industrial real-time Ethernet redundant network, when a single redundant network fails, the system can switch without delay, greatly improving the reliability of the industrial control system communication network

articleTitle: Research on the Design of Ultra-Lightweight Convolutional Neural Network Accelerator
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Convolutional neural network has been proved to have a wide range of applications and excellent results in the field of target recognition and image segmentation. However, the huge network scale and weight parameters of convolutional neural network make its computational complexity too high, and the required computing and storage resources increase rapidly with the increase of network layers, which makes it difficult to deploy in embedded computing systems with strict requirements on resources and power consumption, which restricts the development of embedded computing systems in the direction of high intelligence. Aiming at the demand of ultra-light intelligent computing in embedded computing system with limited resources, an optimized full-stream convolutional neural network model acceleration strategy is proposed, and the ultra-light convolutional neural network hardware throttle after the ultra-light processing of the algorithm model is designed, and the reasoning process of the network model is verified based on FPGA. The experimental results show that the accelerator designed in this paper can significantly reduce the occupancy rate of hardware resources and obtain a good algorithm speedup ratio, which has important technical significance for the design of embedded intelligent computing system.

articleTitle: The Voiceprint Recognition Method Based on the ISCL Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Voiceprint recognition is a method for discerning the identity of a person by extracting inherent characteristics from their vocal sounds, and it finds widespread applications in security authentication and privacy protection. In order to enhance the performance of voiceprint recognition, this paper proposes a voiceprint recognition approach based on the Improved SimSiam Contrastive Learning (ISCL) network. This method initially separates noise features from vocal characteristics in voiceprints using a novel wavelet transform based on a hybrid threshold function, reducing noise interference and generating spectrograms. Subsequently, these spectrograms are fed into the ISCL network, and an improved infoNCE loss function is employed to enhance the contrastive effects of voiceprint features and the performance of the contrastive network, ultimately achieving voiceprint recognition. Experimental results demonstrate that incorporating wavelet transform and the infoNCE loss function into the contrastive network significantly improves the accuracy of voiceprint recognition. The use of the hybrid threshold function reduces the adverse effects of noise on the network.

articleTitle: Design of Surface defect Detection system for Tungsten Rod based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Aiming at the tungsten bar surface defect detection in the production process relies on manual completion, identification of low efficiency, slow speed, labor intensity and other issues, this paper designs a set of tungsten bar surface defect detection system based on machine vision and FPGA hardware platform. The image collected by the image sensor by Gaussian filtering, gray scale conversion, median filtering, threshold segmentation, morphological processing to obtain the binarized feature map, and then use the pixel mutation algorithm to identify the tungsten rod surface defect features, and realize the FPGA hardware deployment. Finally, the experimental platform is built to experimentally verify the algorithm, and the experimental results show that: the system operates stably, the accuracy Ac reaches 92%, and the normal tungsten rod recognition F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">NR</inf> reaches 96%, which can be applied to the actual production to improve the production efficiency and reduce the production cost.

articleTitle: High Speed Target Motion Compensation Algorithm for Terminal Guidance Radar Based on Frequency Stepping
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: To address the problem of range-Doppler coupling caused by frequency stepping terminal guidance radar, which leads to the shift and broadening of the range correlation peak of high-speed relative motion targets, a motion parameter estimation algorithm based on fractional Fourier transform (FrFT) was designed. According to the characteristics of the target echo beat frequency signal being a linear frequency modulation signal and the relationship between signal parameters and target motion parameters, the FrFT was used to estimate the parameters of the target echo beat frequency signal to obtain the target speed and range estimation results, and the accuracy of motion parameter estimation was quantitatively derived. For the optimization problem of the order of FrFT, a fast search algorithm for frequency modulation based on golden section search method was designed, and the algorithm was extended to multi-target detection scenarios. The effectiveness of the algorithm was verified through matlab simulation, and the results showed that the algorithm proposed in this paper can obtain the minimum unbiased estimation of the radial distance and speed of high-speed moving targets, and effectively cope with multi-target detection scenarios.

articleTitle: Research and Development of a Home Security Prevention and Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: As the rapid development of information technology and the great improvement of people's living standards, people have generated the need to install anti-theft and fire-proof home security systems. But the existing home security system, in the use of infrared induction monitoring, easy to appear false alarm, and its use of desktop or server as a monitoring terminal, so it needs special personnel to be on duty, there are deficiencies in the function. This study designs and realizes a new home security alarm system, which can collect image, temperature and smoke data, and automatically transmit it to the owner's mobile phone in real time. The system has the advantages of intuitive image, low false alarm rate and no need of specially-assigned person to be on duty.

articleTitle: Improved Grey Wolf Optimization Algorithm Based on Antisine Inertial Weights
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: An improved Grey Wolf optimization algorithm (AGWO) based on antisine function inertia weight was proposed to solve the problems of slow convergence and local optimum in the optimization of Grey Wolf optimization algorithm (GWO). AGWO improved the optimization performance of GWO by using the nonlinear inertia weight strategy based on arcsine function. Five classical test functions were used to verify the optimization performance of AGWO. The experimental results show that AGWO has better convergence speed, stability and optimization accuracy than other five typical swarm intelligence algorithms.

articleTitle: An EEG Generator Capable of Reconstructing Signals from Any EDF File and Simulating Human Body EEG Collection Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In Electroencephalogram(EEG)-related research, it's common to require EEG signals for testing, often collected directly from the human body. This paper introduces a low-cost MCU-based EEG signal generator that can be used for early validation testing of EEG-related circuits and systems. The generator reads data through PC software or a TF card and generates waveforms using the MCU's DAC ports, allowing for the faithful reproduction of signals from any EDF/BDF file. The amplitude of the generated signals matches real EEG amplitudes. We have designed standard calibration signals with frequency and amplitude errors of less than 1%. The results show that our design produces signals with excellent resolution and real-time capability, accurately simulating EEG signals collected from the human body, meeting the requirements for most teaching and testing scenarios.

articleTitle: A Low-Side-Lobe Transmissive Antenna Based on Linear-to-Circular Polarization Conversion Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In this paper, a low-side-lobe transmissive antenna based on a linear-to-circular polarization conversion metasurface (PCMS) is proposed. It can generate left-handed circularly polarized (LHCP) wave and right-handed circularly polarized (RHCP) wave under the incidence of linearly polarized (LP) wave, respectively. The polarization conversion as well as the independent control of amplitude and phase are achieved using element structure of the receiving-transmitting layer. The amplitude modulation is realized by rotating the metal patch of the receiving layer, while the phase modulation is realized by rotating the metal patch of the transmitting layer. The planar amplitude distribution on the metasurface satisfies the Taylor distribution, which can reduce sidelobe level of the antenna. To generate RHCP waves, phase-only and amplitude-phase-independent modulated metasurfaces are designed and simulated for verification. The comparison results show that the proposed amplitude-phase independent modulation metasurface antenna possesses excellent side-lobe level. Therefore, the proposed low side lobe antenna will be promising for point-to-point wireless and satellite communication applications under interference conditions.

articleTitle: Modeling Analysis of Arc Fault Volt-Current Characteristics of Electrical Power Supply Lines
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: It also offers a theoretical foundation for arc fault detection technology, which is necessary to achieve the effective detection of arc faults. In order to study the static volt-current characteristics of an arc and the effects of resistance, electrical mains voltage, and volt-current characteristics on arc stability, the fundamental features of an arc are used as the basis for this article. A static arc fault model is then created. Analyzed are the arc's dynamic properties under AC power frequencies as well as the voltage and current phase characteristics of the arc fault line during a power frequency half-cycle.

articleTitle: Research on Bad Data Identification Method for Power Information Communication Process
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In traditional electrical power communication processes, the denoising ability of the existing methods for identifying faulty data is inadequate, which results in a diminished identification efficiency. To address this, the present study devises a novel method for identifying faulty data in electrical power information communication processes, grounded in wavelet analysis. Leveraging the singularity characteristic of the wavelet transformation, this method conducts localized singularity detection on the power information communication process. Following the detection, it discriminates between normal and faulty data utilizing neural network algorithms. Subsequently, to eliminate noise-containing signals within the faulty data, both soft and hard threshold denoising techniques are employed. After calculating the noise intensity, the wavelet transformation coefficients within a certain scale are arranged in ascending order based on their squares, and the likelihood estimation vector is computed. The method then proceeds to remove the noise segments within the signal, guided by the minimum and maximum values in the vector. Empirical results illustrate that this approach significantly enhances the denoising capability and bolsters identification efficiency, showcasing its potential as a robust solution in improving the quality and reliability of electrical power communication processes.

articleTitle: Steganography and Pixelation Based Privacy Preserving for Image
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The rapid progression of machine learning has significantly bolstered the potential applications of data utilization, thereby augmenting the inherent value of data. However, the current landscape lacks effective regulatory strategies for data usage across various scenarios, resulting in substantial risks of unauthorized privacy breaches in collected data. Consequently, there is a crucial need to identify and extract private elements from collected data to facilitate both privacy protection and efficient data utilization. This paper introduces a desensitization process aimed at recognizing private elements in image data through semantic segmentation. Additionally, a steganography implementation is incorporated to formulate a splitting and indexing protection scheme for private data. Experimental validation illustrates that the computational cost of the desensitization process in this scheme is comparable to random computational costs. Importantly, the proposed approach accurately restores private information post-authorization, enabling the segmented storage and indexing of data.

articleTitle: KGC-YOLOv5: A YOLOv5-based Method for Steel Surface Defects Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: To address the challenges posed by diverse defect types, significant scale variations, and potential missed detections of small objects on steel surfaces, this paper introduces the KGC-YOLOv5 model, a lightweight steel surface defect detection model based on YOLOv5. Firstly, the K-means++ algorithm is employed instead of the K-means algorithm to cluster anchor boxes, resulting in anchor boxes that are specifically tailored for steel surface defects and improving the quality of the target anchor boxes. Next, in the backbone network, the C3 layer is replaced with C3Ghost to enhance feature extraction capabilities and create a lightweight model. To enrich deep features and facilitate the detection of medium and small objects, we incorporate the lightweight upsampling method known as CARAFE. The experimental results demonstrate that the KGC-YOLOv5 model achieves a mAP of 76.9% on the NEU-DET dataset, showcasing a performance improvement of 3.1% over YOLOv5. Additionally, the model achieves a 4% increase in precision, reduces the number of parameters by 13%, and decreases the GFLOPs by 3.1.

articleTitle: A Study of Deformable Convolutional Forest Fire Recognition Incorporating Attentional Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Forest fire is a destructive natural disaster, which is characterized by uncontrollability and instantaneous explosiveness, making the prevention and control of fire especially critical. In recent years, forest fire detection algorithms for automatic smoke and fire recognition have received extensive attention from researchers at home and abroad. However, in the budding stage of fire, the target features are small and usually hidden, which makes it difficult for traditional target detection methods to achieve effective detection. Convolutional neural network-based feature extraction structure has too many layers, multi-scale feature fusion is too complex, there is a large amount of redundant computational overhead, which in turn affects the operation speed of the algorithm, and the hardware configuration required for its deployment is high, which hinders its practical application in the field of forest fire prevention. In this paper, YOLOV8 is used as the backbone network, and deformable convolution is introduced to improve the effective extraction of irregular features of fire by the neural network; features with dual dimensions of channel attention and spatial attention are fused to enhance the expression ability of features with high weights, which promotes the network's effective identification of flames. The method has performed comparative experiments and ablation experiments on the dataset and achieved competitive results. From the visualization results, the features extracted by the method can effectively train the neural network and improve the fire detection ability.

articleTitle: The Potential of Large Language Models as Tools for Analyzing Student Textual Evaluation: A Differential Analysis Between CS and Non-CS Students
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Research on the analysis of Student Textual Evaluation encounters ongoing challenges. Large language models, as emerging tools in natural language processing, have garnered extensive attention. This study explores the potential of large-scale language models as tools for analyzing student course evaluations on the Coursera platform and compares Computer Science (CS) and non-Computer Science (non-CS) course reviews to investigate variations in student sentiment and thematic content between these two domains. The study adopts a systematic approach to review and analyze student reviews, identifying common sentiments and patterns, and categorizing reviews into relevant evaluation themes. Additionally, the study assesses inter-annotator agreement to validate the accuracy of manual analyses. Experimental findings reveal a strong correlation between large language models and actual course ratings as well as human-analyzed results, suggesting their potential as tools for assessing student course evaluations. Results from the analysis of CS and non-CS course reviews indicate significant disparities in the distribution of thematic content between these two academic domains.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Control System for Negative Pressure Isolation Ward
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In the early days of the new crown epidemic, many medical staff were infected while treating patients, and if negative pressure isolation wards were used, it could effectively reduce the possibility of medical staff being infected in large numbers. Starting from the particularity of the negative pressure isolation ward, this project completes the design of the intelligent control system of the negative pressure isolation ward with reference to the environmental indicators formulated by the state. The system uses the embedded system to collect and process the environmental data of the negative pressure isolation ward, and combines the Internet of Things wireless communication technology to transmit the relevant information to the host computer for realtime display through wireless means; The system can automatically control and adjust the equipment in the ward according to the air pressure data, temperature and humidity data of different areas of the negative pressure isolation ward detected in real time; The system alerts when it detects that the environment has changed abnormally and exceeded the threshold set by the system.

articleTitle: Online Visual Localization Combining Space and Feature Distance Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Visual Localization is widely used in autonomous driving, virtual reality, and autonomous robot applications. However, the existing visual localization solutions require a cumbersome sparse scene model and suffer from coarse place recognition, making inefficient and inaccurate localization. To resolve these challenges, we present a visual localization solution adopting an online local reconstruction method and a space and feature distance constraints (SFDC) place recognition strategy. Comprehensive experiments confirm that the SFDC improves place recognition precision by about 50% over the popular visual localization method. Besides, the proposed method can achieve faster localization results by performing local online reconstruction of the retrieved images than traditional methods.

articleTitle: Research on Electrical Energy Allocation Strategies based on Nash Equilibrium
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the continuous increase of electrical resource demands, the reasonable energy allocation strategy can boost the effective utilization of energy and reduce carbon emission. However, existing allocation methods only concentrate the auction mechanism and ignore the equilibrium allocation. In this work, we propose a novel allocation strategy by deploying the double-sided auction mechanism and guarantee the fairness of proposed method. Subsequently, the Nash equilibrium theory is applied the proposed mechanism to achieve the optimization of allocation results. Finally, we compare our model with existing strategies in identical allocation data-set. From our extensive analysis, we can conclude the model can achieve the allocation for electrical resources with effective responses and acceptable social welfare.

articleTitle: Deep Dual-Branch Network: Design and Optimization of High-Accuracy Sky Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper presents an innovative network based on deep learning for sky segmentation, a key task in image processing. Sky segmentation has various applications in computer vision, but traditional methods struggle to meet accuracy and efficiency requirements due to the diverse and complex nature of the sky in different scenes. To address this challenge, we propose a semantic-detail dual-branch sky segmentation network that draws inspiration from the visual characteristics and segmentation needs of the sky. The network aims to enhance the accuracy and detail sensitivity of the sky area through the parallel design of the semantic branch and the detail branch, along with the introduction of a feature fusion module. We train the network using the AED20K subset of datasets, which enables fine segmentation of sky regions. Through extensive experiments on multiple datasets, we demonstrate that our network achieves significant performance improvements in sky segmentation tasks, delivering excellent accuracy and outstanding sensitivity to detail.

articleTitle: Robot Autonomous Exploration Mapping Based on FD-RRT
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In order to enhance the autonomous exploration efficiency of robots in unknown environments, this study proposes a Fast Double Rapidly Exploring Random Tree (FD-RRT) algorithm. The algorithm combines a globally exploring random tree with adaptive step size and a locally exploring random tree with directional bias, aiming to quickly locate the boundary points of the map. In the algorithm design, considerations encompass information gain of the map, redundancy of information in boundary points, and navigation cost of the robot. Simultaneously, by eliminating the redundant information in boundary points and based on the gain in boundary information and exploration cost, different cost values are assigned to navigation points, guiding the robot to prioritize the exploration of regions with lower costs. The effectiveness of the proposed strategy is validated through a series of simulation experiments and real-world applications.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Improved Yolov5 for Insulator Defect Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The safety of insulators is related to the stability of power transmission and economic livelihood. UAV inspection has the importance of improving detection efficiency and adapting to complex terrain. In this paper, based on MobileNetV3 and coordinate attention, the YOLOv5 detection algorithm is improved. The number of parameters is reduced by 2.1 GFLOPs compared with the YOLOv5n model, and the ability of the network to learn the relative positions of defects and insulators is strengthened, so that the detection accuracy increases. It has the potential to be applied in UAV transmission line inspection.

articleTitle: Research on Active Defense Model for IPV6 Address Jump
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the construction and development of IPV6 technology in new power systems and the Internet of Things, the security issues of IPv6 technology applications urgently need to be addressed. This article proposes an active defense technology for IPv6 to address hop security issues and conducts experimental verification on the model. Experiments have shown that this model can effectively resist traffic interception and analysis capabilities as well as DoS attacks.

articleTitle: Design of an Auto-Negotiation Logic for SGMII Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the development of Ethernet technology, in order to achieve communication between Ethernet devices at different rates, this article focuses on the Auto-Negotiation function of the SGMII specification, while introducing the generation and basic principles of Auto-Negotiation. This design implements the Auto-Negotiation function of 10/100/1000 M three-speed Ethernet based on the IEEE802.3z protocol in the form of Verilog hardware description and conducts simulation verification. The simulation results indicate that this design achieves efficient transmission of Ethernet data and has high application and promotion value.

articleTitle: Cross-Modal Retrieval Based on Transformer and Label Embedding
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Currently, the explosion of data has stimulated a strong demand for information retrieval. Cross-modal hash retrieval has aroused much attention. However, a majority of cross-modal hash retrieval methods only use convolutional neural networks during data preprocessing, which makes it easy to lose the relative position information, resulting in the inability to obtain more comprehensive multimodal features. In addition, existing retrieval methods tend to only treat label information as a supervisory signal and ignore the unique semantic information about label information for different modalities. To tackle these concerns, an approach combining a transformer network and label embedding network is introduced for the retrieval method. Firstly, during the data preprocessing stage, two separate transformer models and fully connected layers are used for feature extraction, these features are made into corresponding datasets, which will help grasp the features of relative positions; secondly, we will design a label network to embed scaled label features into modality features, which are then fed into an adversarial learning module and an attention module. It captures the semantic features of different modalities and helps bridge the gap between modal semantics. Results obtained from the conducted experiments indicate that the cross-modal hashing approach suggested in this article is more effective than most other methods.

articleTitle: Massive MIMO System For 5G Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In convention MIMO (MIMO) systems, a combination of encoding and pre-coding is used. It has been shown, however, that Minimum Mean Square Error Precoding, Zero Forcing Precoding, and other low complexity linear pre-coding technologies are more useful in large-scale MIMO systems. This article gives a brief introduction to the relevant studies of 5G, mass MIMO, as well as an applied case. In this paper, the fundamental theory and MIMO technique of 5G are presented. Next, we will describe the fundamental theory and key techniques of large-scale MIMO, such as channel estimate, signal detecting and pre-coding. After proving the feasibility of using Massive MIMO in 5G systems, this function has been widely used in the field of wireless communication. The article then lists some practical examples of Massive MIMO, such as Nokia's production of a lightweight and energy-efficient chipset called the ReefShark chipset, which can reduce the size of massive MIMO antennas by half.

articleTitle: Research on Anomaly Detection in Time-Series Streaming Data
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The detection of anomalies in streaming data is crucial in enterprise operations, employing statistical and machine learning methods to identify irregularities. This enhances service stability and reduces operational complexity. However, existing monitoring platforms face challenges such as complex rule configurations and a lack of unified standards. To address these issues, this paper proposes a container performance anomaly detection module that combines statistical and machine learning approaches. This module, through steps including streaming data collection, data preprocessing, anomaly detection models, and monitoring alerts, achieves rapid detection and accurate identification of container performance anomalies. In comparison to traditional monitoring platforms, this module not only saves manpower but also demonstrates higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Image Hiding Scheme Based on Dense Residual Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: A new encoder-decoder steganography scheme, which is based on dense residual connections, is proposed in this paper to address the problem of low image quality in stego-image and message images generated by image steganography schemes relying on encoder-decoder networks. Unlike existing end-to-end image steganography networks, this scheme does not necessitate image preprocessing and utilizes dense residual connections to facilitate the transportation of features from shallow networks to each layer of deep network structures. Consequently, the detailed information of the feature map is effectively preserved. Furthermore, channel and spatial attention modules are employed to filter features, thus enhancing the attention of the encoder-decoder towards complex texture areas in the image. The experimental results obtained from LFW, PASCAL-VOC12, and ImageNet datasets demonstrate the effective enhancement of image quality and algorithm security facilitated by the proposed method. The stego-image and carrier images achieve an average peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of up to 36.2dB and a structural similarity (SSIM) of 0.98, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on Small Target Railway Foreign Object Intrusion Detection Based on YOLOX- Tiny
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Based on the YOLOX- Tiny detection model, a multi-scale fusion and attention-enhanced anchor-less deep learning model for foreign object detection was proposed, which solved the problems of insufficient feature extraction, low detection accuracy, and low real-time performance in railway foreign object intrusion detection. Based on the YOLOX- Tiny model multi-scale FPN pyramid network, a small target detection layer is added to propose a multi-scale weighted bidirectional feature fusion module, which enhances the utilization of feature maps and improves detection accuracy. At the same time, an index attention mechanism is introduced to improve the network structure of YOLOX- Tiny, increase the focus on target regions, and highlight target features in small target scenarios. This approach effectively improved the detection accuracy for small-scale targets and enhanced the convergence speed.

articleTitle: An Improved PBFT Consensus Protocol Based on Node Contribution Incentives
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The consensus protocol is a crucial mechanism to ensure the consistency and security of distributed systems. In this paper, an improved PBFT consensus protocol is proposed, which incorporates node contribution incentives. A reliable consensus node set is formed by dynamically selecting nodes based on their historical involvement in consensus, thereby reducing the presence of malicious nodes. Additionally, we develop a mechanism to incentivize node contribution by distributing consensus income fairly using Shapley value calculation. Moreover, we perform periodic evaluations of node contribution, considering both their consensus income and performance, to enhance node engagement in consensus. Finally, we simulate and analyze the improved PBFT algorithm, demonstrating its benefits in terms of enhancing consensus speed, minimizing communication overhead, and bolstering system resilience against attacks.

articleTitle: A Seismic Phase-Picking Model Transfer Learning Approach Based on Maximum Mean Discrepancy
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Thanks to the abundance of earthquake data and the advancement of deep neural networks, many seismic phase-picking models have been proposed to detect the arrival time of P-waves and S-waves. Currently, the accuracy of these models exceeds that of traditional methods, such as short-term average/long-term average (STA/LTA). While many studies concentrate on phase picks on a single seismic dataset, there is limited research regarding the generalization of phase-picking models. Specifically, applying a model trained on one seismic dataset to an unseen dataset remains underexplored. A phase-picking model is designed in this paper, which consists of an encoder and a decoder. The self-attention is applied in the encoder module to focus seismic features. Then a seismic phase-picking model transfer learning approach based on maximum mean discrepancy (SPPTL-MMD) is proposed to train a universal seismic feature extraction module by utilizing diverse seismic datasets. The module will be transferred and a significantly improved phase-picking model is obtained through fine-tuning techniques. Experiments show that the model after fine-tuning can be generalized to other datasets.

articleTitle: ISAR-iNeRF: Inverting Neural Radiance Fields from ISAR Images for Attitude Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The attitude of space targets is essential information for space security. Estimating the attitude of targets from inverse synthetic aperture radar (ISAR) images has attracted widespread attention. Most existing literature has proved the effectiveness of estimating attitude according to ISAR image features extraction. However, they either require complete information about the target or are limited by feature extraction methods, resulting in relatively low speed and accuracy in attitude estimation. In this paper, we propose a novel attitude estimation method, ISAR-iNeRF, which can quickly and accurately estimate the attitude of a space target. We model neural radiation fields from multi-view ISAR images, which implicitly build up the feature database of targets. A differentiable estimation pipeline is introduced to iteratively update the target's attitude via gradient-based optimization. The experiments demonstrate that the proposed method can achieve fast and accurate attitude estimation.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Indoor Visual Autonomous Navigation System for Quadrotor UAV Based on Binocular Camera and IMU
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Addressing the challenge of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) navigating indoors without satellite positioning, this study introduces a novel method combining binocular camera and inertial measurement unit (IMU) data. This approach overcomes the structural differences between visual and inertial information, integrating them effectively for enhanced indoor autonomous navigation. The research presents a gradient-free path planning framework, pivotal for enhancing the UAV's ability to execute efficient and stable flight in intricate indoor settings. The cornerstone of this system is an advanced path planning algorithm, adept at swiftly identifying optimal routes and adapting to environmental shifts. The system's efficacy was rigorously evaluated through simulations and real-world tests, confirming its precision in positioning and path planning without reliance on satellite data. The findings demonstrate the system's capacity for precise localization and effective route determination, utilizing an integration of visual and inertial inputs. This research significantly contributes to the autonomous flight capabilities of UAVs, offering a valuable reference for future UAV autonomous navigation systems. By delving into visual-inertial fusion navigation technology, the study paves the way for expanded indoor UAV applications.

articleTitle: Research on New Technology of Arc Fault Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In this paper, the US UL1699 standard is used to build an arc fault experimental platform. It also gathers current waveforms of common electrical equipment operating normally, various arc fault current modes, and cascading arc faults. Phase space reconstruction is used to derive the arc fault current and the electrical equipment operating current phase space plan, which is based on the fractal theory of the fractal dimension proposed for the analysis of this plan. The first feature's calculated fractal dimension was obtained by analyzing the time domain features of the electrical equipment's current waveform and the waveform of arc faults. The second feature was the corresponding zero rest time, which was determined. The methodology was implemented using Matlab software, and the simulation results demonstrated the method's viability and validity. Two feature values were extracted and used as a double criterion for arc defect detection.

articleTitle: Parallel Network Vehicle Detection Algorithm with Hybrid Reinforcement Features
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Single stage algorithms are renowned for their fast detection speed and low parameter counts, and have been widely used in vehicle detection. However, the scale of vehicle detection targets is variable and greatly affected by the environment. To address this situation, use parallel network enhancement algorithm was proposed to enhance the performance of object detection through image enhancement; And enhance channel and spatial perception, emphasizing target features by CBAM attention mechanism; Simultaneously using the EIOU loss function to assist in the model's bounding box localization ability; Finally, the various modules of the model were optimized to maintain real-time performance. The experimental results on the BIT vehicle dataset show that compared with YOLOv8n, the proposed algorithm has a stable improvement in all six categories of targets, with an overall improvement of 1.4%, and a slight improvement in real-time performance of 1.3 FPS.

articleTitle: Pavement Crack Segmentation Network Based on Local Diagonal Gray Scale Transformation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Pavement crack segmentation aims to identify and localize crack objects, in order to solve the problems such as the influence of complex texture noise in the crack background on segmentation and the misidentification of fine cracks, a crack segmentation network based on local diagonal grayscale transformation algorithm (LDGT-IterNet) is proposed. Firstly, the Local Diagonal Grayscale Transformation (LDGT) algorithm is used to preprocess the crack image, which converts the grayscale image into a 4-channel image with constant contrast according to the grayscale order between each pixel and its diagonal neighboring pixels along the four directions, preserving the structural intrinsic features of the crack curves and at the same time making the contrast change robust; Then, Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) is introduced between the basic and refined modules of IterNet segmentation network to improve the performance of the segmentation network by mining the feature map detail information. In order to verify the robustness of the proposed method, experimental comparison and validation is carried out on Crack500, CFD and Crack200 datasets. The F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>-score of the method is 85.47%, 87.95% and 86.82% on the three datasets, respectively. It shows that the method can effectively segment pavement cracks and provide more accurate information for road maintenance.

articleTitle: Dual-Channel Decoupling Marching with Density Relationship Global Fusion for Few-shot Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Traditional deep learning approaches to object recognition typically require large datasets, and acquiring high-quality annotated data prohibitively expensive. Consequently, there has been a growing interest in few-shot object detection, which aims to classify and detect novel classification with only a limited number of samples. Existing methods do not fully exploit feature matching between support images and query images. We propose called the dual-channel decoupled matching with density relationship global fusion method for few-shot object detection. The dual-channel decoupled matching backbone network is specifically designed to mitigate the mutual interference between support features and query features, enabling the extraction of diverse information and improving the model's generalization capability. In order to perceive a more comprehensive feature information, the density relationship global fusion module utilizes feature information of different scales to obtain a more comprehensive feature representation. Extensive experiments conducted on the PASCAL VOC datasets validate the efficacy of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Distance Perception Engineering Quantity Accounting Technology of Transmission Line Grounding Device Based on Binocular Stereo Vision AnyNet Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper studies the distance perception engineering quantity accounting technology of transmission line grounding device based on binocular stereo vision AnyNet network. This paper introduces a binocular stereo matching algorithm using deep learning to estimate the depth of the scene. By combining lightweight binocular stereo matching technology and deep neural network, high-precision grounding grid depth length recognition is realized. This method can quickly generate high-precision disparity map through multi-stage prediction and disparity image element correction, improve the accuracy and efficiency of engineering quantity accounting, reduce human error, and ensure the objectivity and reliability of accounting results.

articleTitle: Small-Size Surface Defect Detection Algorithm for Quartz Wafers Based on YOLO-DDTBlock
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The quartz wafer surface defect detection method uses object detection algorithm to classify and locate the defects on the wafer surface. Due to the small size and large number of surface defects of quartz wafer, the conventional target detection model is not so effective. This paper proposes a DDTBlock (Double Detection Block) module to optimize the detection. The DDTBlock module performs super resolution reconstruction of regions with low confidence, detects the reconstructed image and fuses the results. Since the DDTBlock module increases the amount of computation, this paper optimizes the backbone network to reduce the prediction time. Taking YOLOv4 as an example, the average detection time decreases from 31ms per frame to 22ms per frame, and the mAP increases from 10.1 to 21.8.

articleTitle: Research on Improved A * Algorithm for Camera Path Planning in VR Movie Shooting
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The use of A * algorithm for camera path planning is crucial for introducing scene information in virtual reality (VR) movie shooting. In order to solve the problems of long redundant paths, slow pathfinding speed, multiple turning points and large turning angles in the traditional A <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*</sup> algorithm during the pathfinding process, resulting in abrupt and unnatural transitions in the captured movie images, this paper improves the traditional A <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*</sup> algorithm.
