Firstly, by calculating the ratio of the standard deviation from the current point to the target point and the standard deviation from the starting point to the target point, the weights of the heuristic function of the A <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*</sup> algorithm are adaptively adjusted to achieve a balance between path length and path quality during the pathfinding process; Then, by changing the selection method of the extended sub nodes in the algorithm, the number of inflection points in the path is reduced without increasing the path length; Finally, the A * algorithm is combined with a cubic B-spline curve, and the path planned by the A * algorithm is smoothed using the local smoothness characteristics of B-splines. The experimental results show that the improved A * algorithm has faster path finding speed, fewer redundant inflection points in the path, smoother path, and the movie captured by the camera according to the planned path is more coherent and smooth compared to the traditional A * algorithm, while ensuring comprehensive scene information.

articleTitle: Calculation and Application of Trusted Carbon Footprint in Power Supply Chain Based on LCA
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of large carbon emission detection error and low carbon footprint measurement accuracy of power supply chain, a reliable carbon footprint measurement system of power supply chain based on LCA is designed. The existing blockchain artificial intelligence algorithm is improved by integrating different scale and dimension characteristics, which improves the analysis and calculation ability of the carbon footprint of the power supply chain. The Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) algorithm is used for standard control of abnormal data. Blockchain technology is introduced to build a carbon footprint measurement network, and the reliable collection of carbon footprint data of the supply chain is realized. The experiment shows that the data error rate of the system is within the acceptable range, which lays a foundation for other technical research.

articleTitle: LM-Net-Dual: A Two Branch Spatiotemporal Feature Extraction Model for Dynamic Gestures Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Dynamic gesture recognition is one of the important technologies in human-computer interaction. Leap Motion Controller can capture the coordinate data of key points of the hand, and is widely used in Gesture recognition. Current works usually rely on manual feature extraction for LMC-based gesture recognition. The purpose of this paper is to propose an end-to-end dynamic gesture recognition scheme in real time. A spatiotemporal data recoding method is proposed, which recodes the original data containing the spatial and temporary features returned by LMC, so that 2D convolution can extract features from space and temporary dimensions. The proposed two branch model LM-Net-Dual based on task splitting can focus on finger posture and hand movement separately, improving the discrimination of similar gestures. In addition, a real-time dynamic gesture recognition scheme based on sliding time window and confidence limit is proposed. The proposed model is trained and tested on dataset LM-16 which contains 16 dynamic gestures, achieving an accuracy of 100%.

articleTitle: Yolov7-ODCA: Object Detection of Pomelo Epidermis Defects Based on Improved YOLOv7
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The detection of pomelo epidermis defects plays an essential role in the mechanization and automation of pomelo. However, pomelo epidermis defect data possesses characteristics such as small targets and low contrasts, which brings great challenges to general object detectors. To address these issues, we propose an improved YOLOv7 network, namely YOLOv7-ODCA. The feature extraction process was improved based on the YOLOv7 network through optimization of the CBS module, and the ODCBS module was proposed by introducing the Omni-dimensional dynamic convolution (ODConv) and residual structure. This aims to enhance the feature extraction capability of CNN for low contrast images. Additionally, a Context Aggregation Block (CABlock) has been integrated in the detection head to address the issue of excessive irrelevant background information in images with small target defects. In the experiments, we compare the proposed YOLOv7-ODCA networks in the metrics of AP, AP50, precision, and recall. It achieves average accuracies exceeding all compared networks, with values of 49.8%, 92.6%, 87.6%, and 85.2%, respectively.

articleTitle: The Impact of Form Controls and User Characteristics on the Information Experience of Database Users
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The information retrieval experience has a significant impact on the use of university library database resources. In order to improve the efficiency of users' information retrieval in the database, a controlled experimental method is adopted to explore the effects of form controls and user types on the performance, cognitive load, and satisfaction of university library digital resource information retrieval tasks, and provide design optimization suggestions. The study found that form controls have a significant impact on cognitive load, task performance, and subjective evaluation, and there is an interactive effect between user characteristics and form controls on cognitive load and task performance. Novice users have the highest retrieval efficiency when using drop-down list boxes, and experienced users are more suitable for using combo boxes.

articleTitle: Predictive Control of Grid-Connected Inverter Models Based on Finite Phase Angle Set Phase-Locked Loops
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: An improved phase-locked loop (PLL) is proposed to simplify the tuning process for predictive control of the grid-connected inverter model. Firstly, an improved PLL is proposed based on the idea of finite control set, which avoids the use of PI controller and simplifies the tuning process. In addition, in order to reduce the computation of the finite control set based PLL, an iterative search algorithm is designed to lock out the optimal phase angle based on the idea of the golden search method, and the iterative phase angle accuracies of the existing finite control set PLL and the proposed PLL are analysed and compared, and the optimal phase angle is applied to the predictive control. Finally, the control performance of the conventional PI-PLL and the proposed PLL is compared by simulation and experiment, and the results prove that the proposed PLL has an extremely fast dynamic response and good grid-connection effect after being applied to predictive current control.

articleTitle: Reversible Hiding in Encrypted Domain Based on Threshold-Changeable Secret Image Sharing
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: To solve the problem that current reversible data hiding in encrypted domain (RDH-ED) cannot be applied to the distributed variable security environment, an RDH-ED scheme based on improved threshold-changeable secret image sharing (ITCSIS) is proposed. Firstly, the threshold-changeable secret image sharing (TCSIS) is improved by image scrambling and random hiding keys to make better security. Then, the extra data is embedded into the binary polynomial coefficient redundancy generated in the encryption process of ITCSIS, which improves the embedding performance and security. The experimental results show that the proposed scheme is completely reversible, and obtains a better security and embedding rate. Besides, it's suitable for distributed scenarios with complex and variable security environments.

articleTitle: An Improved Gradient-Based Image Sharpness Evaluation Method for Variable Focusing Window
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: To address the focusing challenges of varying scales at different time points of moving target images in space, we propose an improved gradient-based image sharpness evaluation method for variable focusing window. The method obtains the target focusing window adaptively and computes the sharpness evaluation value by convolving the image within the focusing window with a multi-directional gradient operator weighted factor. Experiments show that the method exhibits strong sensitivity and anti-interference capabilities, contributing to the improved performance of the space imaging autofocus system.

articleTitle: A WPSD-Based Feature Extraction Method of EEG Signal for Motor Imagination
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In order to improve the performance of the Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) system, it is important to extract the feature vector which reflects nonlinearity and non-stationary of Electroencephalogram (EEG) signals. This paper proposed an adaptive feature extraction method for BCI system based on multiclass motor imagery EEG signals. The proposed method extracts a feature vector related with time-frequency-spatial information of multiclass EEG signals from the continuous wavelet transform power spectral density (CWT-PSD) difference weighted by weight matrices which reflect the time-varying of EEG signals, in some channels which reflect well multiclass motor imagery. This method was evaluated on the EEG signals of BCI Competition IV Datasets <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2\mathrm{a}$</tex> using SVM as classifier, and the performance results were compared with the results obtained by the Common Spatial Pattern (CSP) and Filter Band CSP (FBCSP) feature extraction method used Naïve Bayesian Parzen Window (NBPW) classifier. The average classification accuracy of the proposed method is 90.22% for the 4-class motor imagery based BCI, and the kappa coefficient of the proposed method is higher 1.38 times and 1.21 times than one of the CSP and FBCSP method, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on Feature-based Image Recognition based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Recently, image identification has achieved promising performance and become the most essential component in real-life image-based applications through training a machine learning model. However, existing methods extract the features and the identification accuracy is almost depended on these features with extractions process, which is the fundamental process for learning models. Existing methods are almost concentrated on the utilization of these feature and ignore the process of extracting procedure. As far as we can concern, the image features contain numerous information and can assist the learning model to enhance the identification accuracy. In this work, we initially utilize a convolutional neural network to obtain the features in the feature space. Subsequently, an attention mechanism and the feature clustering are applying to optimize the extracted features. Finally, we evaluate our proposed model with most used methods in the identical environment setups. From our extensive experimental results, we can observe that our model outperforms compared methods with reasonable computation costs.

articleTitle: Panoramic Image Quality Evaluation Method Based on Multi-Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Panoramic images are different from traditional 2D images, panoramic images can provide viewers with a broader perspective. Based on the human visual system and panoramic images, this paper proposes a new quality evaluation method for panoramic images based on calculating the feature. human visual system and panoramic images, this paper proposes a new quality evaluation method for panoramic images based on calculating feature-similarity in CMP format. The method firstly converts the ERP format image to CMP format image, i.e., the features under CMP format for similarity calculation. Then the structural and texture feature similarity of the image is calculated using the second-order phase consistency mutual information and local entropy similarity. Then the structural and texture feature similarity of the image is calculated using the second-order phase consistency mutual information and local entropy similarity. In addition, the method also extracts the gradient features and color features of the reference image and the distorted image, and calculates the similarity between them respectively. Finally, these four feature similarities are fused to obtain the objective quality score of the panoramic image. Experimental results on the OIQA dataset show that the method proposed in this paper has better performance than the state-of-the-art OIOA method. state-of-the-art OIOA model.

articleTitle: Finite Element Simulation Analysis of Flexible Wheel Parameters of Robot Harmonic Reducer
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Aiming at the phenomenon of stress concentration affecting the service life of the flexible wheel of harmonic reducer, ANSYS finite element statics method is used to simulate it. Based on the Design Expert software, Box-Behnken experimental design and response surface method were applied to optimize the three parameters of flexwheel wall thickness, cylinder length and arc radius at the connection between tooth and cylinder, and the artificial gorilla optimization algorithm was used to correct the results of the actual factor regression equation of response surface method. The influence of these three parameters on the maximum equivalent stress of the flexwheel of the harmonic reducer is studied. The results show that the effect of the maximum equivalent stress on the flexwheel of harmonic reducer is the length of cylinder, the wall thickness and the radius of the circular arc at the joint of the cylinder. After modification, the optimal dimensions of cylinder length, wall thickness and arc radius at the joint of cylinder are 49mm, 0.55mm and 8.516mm, respectively. At this time, the minimum maximum equivalent stress is 226.1963MPa, and the prediction error is 3.2% verified by ANSYS simulation experiment.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation of a High-Performance SM2 Coprocessor
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: To enhance the performance of cryptographic servers, this study proposes a high-performance hardware implementation focusing on the scalar multiplication operation of the SM2 algorithm. Through a thorough analysis of the SM2 algorithm, we employed the Karatsuba-Ofman algorithm to design the multiplier, targeting time-consuming multiplication operations to reduce computational load and decrease latency. The implementation of fast modular reduction further improved the speed of modular reduction operations. For the scalar multiplication operation, we adopted the hardware implementation of the Width-w Non-Adjacent Form scalar multiplication algorithm to meet the requirements of resisting SPA attacks and reducing computational load. Experimental results demonstrate that the speed of scalar multiplication can reach 0.256ms per operation, achieving a favorable balance between resource consumption and performance.

articleTitle: Research on a Hyperspectral Rice Yield Estimation Model Based on Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This article analyzes and selects 18 characteristic parameters in different growing period and vegetation Index, and establishes 6 random forest model algorithms with different types of parameters for rice yield estimation. Main to analyze the influence of the two key parameters of nTree and Depth in the random forest algorithm on the model accuracy, and analyzing the rice yield estimation accuracy of the six random forest models. The experimental results indicate that: First, the nTree parameter has little effect of the model accuracy. Second, a small Depth value has a significant impact on model accuracy. When the Depth value is greater than 6, the model accuracy tends to stabilize. Third, The training effect of the RF-der model is the best among the six models, while the accuracy of the RF-R and RF-ref models is relatively low. Forth, the first derivative of rice canopy spectrum and vegetation index are more suitable for estimation. Fifth, the spectral indices of heading and filling stages are more suitable for estimating rice yield.

articleTitle: HLSTMCNN: A Hybrid Deep Learning Model to Detect Phishing Email
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Phishing emails pose a threat and can have serious consequences. Traditional methods and standard models often need help to detect these emails due to imbalanced datasets and limited feature extraction capabilities. This research paper proposes an HLSTMCNN model, which utilizes deep learning techniques to address these challenges. The LSTM layer captures time dependencies in emails, while the CNN layer extracts local features, enabling pattern identification representative of phishing attempts. The model also employs GloVe embeddings and a global max pooling layer to address limited feature extraction. Experimental results show that on the real-world dataset, compared to traditional models, HLSTMCNN can achieve higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Fixed-time consensus algorithms for multi-agent systems with bounded disturbances
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper investigates the problem of fixed-time consistency consensus for second-order multi-agent systems under bounded disturbances. The proposed control protocol guarantees fixed-time consistency. First, a virtual velocity is proposed and a class of fixed-time consistency control protocols for multi-intelligent systems under bounded perturbations is designed. The multi-agents converge to consistency in fixed time by tracking the virtual velocity, and the upper bound on the convergence time is independent of the initial state. Subsequently, the stability of the control algorithm is demonstrated by using Lyapunov stability theory and algebraic graph theory. The paper also gives sufficient conditions and upper bounds on the convergence time for a multi-intelligent system to achieve fixed-time consistency. Finally, the validity of the proposed fixed-time consistency algorithm and the theoretical results are verified by simulation examples.

articleTitle: Prior-YOLO: Enhancing Intelligent Vehicle Small Object Detection with Driving Status-Informed YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In the realm of intelligent vehicles, the evolution of object detection algorithms is of paramount importance. Current deep learning-based methodologies excel in identifying medium to large-sized objects but often falter with smaller entities. A notable research gap exists in integrating key vehicular state data, such as velocity and steering angle, into generally designed object detection frameworks. To bridge these gaps, we present Prior-YOLO, a novel modification of YOLO v8, marked by advanced network structure and refined inference processes. This adaptation includes a dedicated head for small object detection and a new neck component. We have also curated a custom dataset, particularly for algorithm development and validation. This dataset, enriched with critical driving status data, is rigorously annotated to maximize precision. Furthermore, we introduce the Visual Center of Mass Method (VCM), a groundbreaking technique that integrates the driver's focal point to identify the region of interest (ROI) in each image, enhancing auxiliary inference. Our comprehensive experimental evaluations demonstrate significant improvements, with a notable increase of up to 6.04% in Average Precision (AP) and up to 5.44% in Average Precision for Small Objects (APs) across all objects. Most impressively, we observe a 9.24% increase in AP and a 12.59% rise in APs for critical objects, solidifying the effectiveness of Prior-YOLO in intelligent vehicle applications.

articleTitle: Dynamic Scene SLAM Algorithm Based on Target Detection and K-Means Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the camera cannot be accurately localised due to the interference of dynamic objects in the environment, an RGBD SLAM algorithm for dynamic scenes is proposed, which combines the target detection algorithm with the K-means clustering algorithm to separate the dynamic and static feature points in the environment, and is able to remove the dynamic feature points while retaining the static background points of better quality. The algorithm is simulated in the TUM dynamic Simulation experiments were carried out in the TUM dynamic sequence dataset, and the experiments show that the algorithm has good positioning and tracking effect in both high and low dynamic scenes, especially in the high dynamic scene, compared with the traditional ORBSLAM2 algorithm, the camera's absolute trajectory rms error decreases from 94.2% to 95.96%, which substantially improves the positioning accuracy and robustness of the camera's position estimation in the high dynamic scene.

articleTitle: FPGA-Based Ultrasonic Transducer Signal IIR Filtering Treatment
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: During the operation of the ultrasonic transducer, factors such as temperature, load, and wear cause the resonant frequency of the transducer to deviate. Therefore, it is necessary to quickly and real-time track the resonant frequency of the ultrasonic transducer. The voltage and current signals under the working state of the transducer are severely interfered by harmonics, which greatly affects the realization of frequency tracking. Based on the principle of IIR filtering, the signal is filtered with FPGA as the core, and a digital parameter configurable IIR filter is designed for different resonant frequency transducers. The received original signal is filtered for frequency tracking. This article uses a 40kHz resonant frequency transducer as the experimental object. It has been verified that this digital filter can effectively filter out harmonic signals and has practical guiding significance for achieving frequency tracking of ultrasonic transducers.

articleTitle: Research on Model of Graphite Spraying Powder Feeder of Control Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Along with the development process of intelligentization, graphite spraying technology has been applied in many fields, such as manufacturing, new energy and so on. The amount of graphite powder transported through the powder feeder directly affects the quality of the spraying process, so the optimization study of powder transmission in the powder feeder is very significant. Firstly, a suitable linear regression analysis model was established through the analysis of 21 groups of sample data, having found an optimal match between the powder feeder inlet flow and the motor speed, based on the small number of sampling data in a single set of samples, the grey system GM (1, 1) was selected to establish the prediction model. After verification, the prediction model has high accuracy and effectiveness, which will have certain reference value for future research on powder feeders.

articleTitle: Path Planning of Mobile Robot Based on Improved Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of slow convergence and easy falling into local optimization in path planning of mobile robot, an improved ant colony algorithm is proposed. The improved algorithm can enhance the performance of path planning from three aspects. Firstly, based on the environmental information, the obstacle avoidance factor and heuristic function are introduced to improve the searching efficiency at early-stage; Secondly, a high-quality ant pheromone updating rule is suggested to enhance the algorithm's convergence speed; Finally, based on the searched path, a self-adaptive pheromone evaporation factor is used to improve the global searching capability. In two different experimental environments, the improved colony algorithm have better performance in path length and convergence speed than other algorithm.

articleTitle: Robust Federated Learning Based on Chained Self-Paced Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Federated learning is a framework that enables distributed collaborative training while preserving data privacy, and it has great potential for enhancing diagnostics in the medical field. Due to the reluctance of participating institutions to disclose or share details of their models, they design their own network architectures. However, this heterogeneity in models makes it challenging to ensure that all client-collected data in federated learning is correctly annotated, inevitably leading to noise. Therefore, we propose a spiral self-training strategy to address the issue of internal client noise, combating corrupted label noise through reweighted aggregation updates across different time periods. Our proposed federated learning approach improves the original baseline by 5.30% under a noise rate of 0.1 and the pairflip noise scheme. Under symflip noise, it achieves a 5.87% improvement. Similarly, at a noise rate of 0.2, there is a substantial improvement. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms recent state-of-the-art methods on noisy label data.

articleTitle: Configuration and Coordinated Operation Strategy of Integrated Energy Substation for New-Type Power System Construction
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The configuration and coordinated operation strategy of integrated energy substation are proposed under the background of New-power system. The configuration method is in order to solve the problems of scale optimization design and coordinated operation. The problems contain electric vehicle charging station, 5G communication base station, data center, distributed photovoltaic and energy storage station with constraints of site conditions, function integration and business requirements. The inter station function integration scheme is proposed through in-depth analysis of the current development resource requirements of each station and the possibility of inter station function integration. In order to improve the utilization rate of spare space in the existing substation, the capacity optimization configuration model of each station and the coordinated control strategy between stations are established. Finally, the established optimization model is solved by Gurobi. The effectiveness of configuration method and economic optimization is verified by typical examples.

articleTitle: TFC-net: Transfer Fusion-Compression Learning Network for Few-Shot Surface Defect Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Defect detection is a prevailing application within industry, while the scarcity of defect sample set a challenge for general deep learning method which requires enormous data for training. Considering the problem of few-shot learning in surface defect detection, inspired by transfer learning, we propose a two-stage TFC-net (Transfer Fusion and Compression few-shot learning network). For Transfer Fusion (TF) module, we fuse three networks pretrained on large scale dataset as prior knowledge to extract feature of defect samples and unify the feature distribution. For Transfer Compression (TC) module, we gradually mining representative feature of distinct defects to make classification. Experiments carried on three surface defect datasets extensively show our method achieves superior performance compared with competing methods, while the transfer speed consistent with metric learning which requires no training.

articleTitle: A Robust Method for Estimating Periods of Block Interleavers
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: For estimating the period of a block interleaver, the robustness of Gaussian elimination-based method is not high. To overcome this limitation, a modified estimation method is proposed. The interleaved sequence is reshaped into a matrix firstly. Then Gaussian elimination is used to estimate the rank of the matrix, and if the number of matrix columns is a multiple of the period of the block interleaver, the matrix is of deficient rank. In the procedure of Gaussian elimination, the threshold of judging dependence of the columns is revised and soft-decision data is used to select reliable bits to decrease bit errors in the matrix. Compared with original method, the robustness of our method improves.

articleTitle: Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance Research for Mobile Robots Incorporating Improved A-Star Algorithm and DWA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Aiming at the traditional A-star algorithm path search time is longer, more turning points, and the search path is not safe and smooth enough. A new path planning method incorporating the improved A-star algorithm and DWA algorithm is proposed to solve the path planning problem of localized dynamic obstacle avoidance for mobile robots. On the basis of analyzing the principle, advantages and disadvantages of traditional A-star algorithm path planning, we improve the operation efficiency of the algorithm by reducing the search direction of traditional A-star algorithm and deleting the redundant nodes in the middle. And introduce the DWA algorithm to realize dynamic obstacle avoidance of the robot. The experimental results show that the fused algorithm can plan a reasonable and smooth running path in the region where dynamic obstacles exist. It also has better obstacle avoidance effect while ensuring the safety of the robot.

articleTitle: LE-YOLO: A Novel Lightweight Object Detection Method
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Traditional large-scale deep neural networks have the characteristics of complex structure, multiple levels, and a large number of nodes, which require a lot of computing resources and are difficult to deploy on edge devices with limited resources. How to lightweight large-scale networks without affecting the performance of feature extraction and classification has important theoretical value and practical needs and is also one of the hot research directions in the field of deep learning. This paper proposes a new lightweight target detection network LE-YOLO, which replaces YOLO backbone network with EMO network, modifies Ghost module, replaces the first GhostConv with learned group convolution, adds coordinate attention module, replaces C3 module in Neck, and finally further improves accuracy through knowledge distillation. Experimental results show that the proposed model achieves better target detection accuracy than the existing mainstream lightweight methods on the test set, and effectively compresses the network size, which verifies the progressiveness of the algorithm proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: A Real-time Monitoring System for Power Consumption and Junction Temperature of DSP Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the continuous development of chip technology integration, chip heating and power consumption has become a serious problem affecting the system reliability. The chip junction temperature monitoring and increase in power consumption have become very important especially for the DSP chips with low power meter requirements. In this paper, a new measurement method for junction temperature and power consumption of DSP devices is designed based on the CCS platform. It can realize the realtime and accurate monitoring of chip junction temperature and power consumption. A variety of feasibility tests were carried out by varying its temperature stress and the load condition of the MSP430FR5969 chip. The test condition was calibrated and verified with Energy Trace technology, and the power consumption and junction temperature curves under different load conditions were obtained along with the temperature boundary. This method provides an important reference for the reliability research and low power design of DSP chip.

articleTitle: A Three-Dimensional Path Planning Method for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles Based on Improved Dung Beetle Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: A heuristic algorithm based unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) for path planning in mountainous areas has slow convergence speed, poor path planning quality, and is prone to falling into local optima. The present study proposes an enhanced UAV 3D path planning approach based on the dung beetle optimization algorithm to tackle this issue. The improvement method is as follows: introducing a reverse learning strategy involving lens-based imaging into the conventional dung beetle optimization algorithm to expand exploration within the search space, thereby balancing local optimization and global optimization capabilities; During the reproduction stage of dung beetles, a dynamic helical exploration approach is implemented to broaden the search span and enhance the speed of convergence; During the foraging stage of dung beetles, an optimal value guidance strategy is introduced to guide the generation of candidate solutions. Compared with traditional dung beetle optimization algorithms, The findings indicate that the improved method proposed in this paperexhibits enhanced rate of convergence and is not easily trapped in local optima. The simulation experiment of mountain path planning shows that this method improves the quality of path planning by 11.52% compared to traditional algorithms.

articleTitle: Coverage Path Planning with Minimum Cost Suitable for Sidewalk
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The coverage path planning problem aims to find a route that can avoid all obstacles and pass through all points in the region of interest. In this article, we propose a method for solving path coverage of robots in pedestrian scenes. Firstly, this method can select the optimal coverage path between the roadside trees on the sidewalk based on the performance of the robot. Secondly, the proposed method greatly improves the efficiency of path generation in curved scenes, without generating too many turning paths due to too many vertices in the bends. Finally, the optimal path connection method and pruning method were proposed. Our planner achieved an average 27% lower path cost than the improved traditional coverage planner.

articleTitle: Sparse Unfolding Network Based on Adaptive Thresholds for SAR Tomography
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Tomographic Synthetic Aperture Radar (TomoSAR) has garnered significant interest due to its capability for three-dimensional reconstruction along the elevation direction from multiple observations. The traditional TomoSAR imaging method has poor imaging effects and low accuracy. After introducing CS to TomoSAR, although the imaging accuracy has been improved, the imaging method based on CS requires hundreds or thousands of iterations, resulting in long calculation times and low efficiency. Additionally, manual parameter tuning poses a challenge, hindering the widespread adoption of TomoSAR applications. In this paper, we propose a novel adaptive-threshold and adaptive network to overcome the TomoSAR imaging problem, called AT-AdaNet, namely the sparse unfolding network, based on the AdaLISTA architecture. Traditional methods rely on fixed threshold values for selection, which cannot adapt to varying noise levels or signal characteristics in different scenarios. Therefore, we introduce an adaptive threshold module to adopt different signal charact-eristics, enhancing the accuracy of network imaging. In addition, the experiment verifies that our proposed network yields superior imaging results for layover targets better than the conventional solver.

articleTitle: A Deep Neural Network-Based Classification Scheme for Encrypted and Compressed Traffic
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Encrypted traffic analysis is a vital area of research in network traffic analysis. The similarity in statistical distribution between compressed and encrypted traffic presents a challenge for effectively analyzing encrypted traffic. To address this, this study proposes a classification model based on deep neural networks that leverages the stochastic characteristics of encrypted and compressed traffic, as well as the disparities in byte distribution patterns. Experimental results demonstrate that the classification accuracy achieves 77% for 1 KB data lengths and remarkably increases to 99.6% when the data length is extended to 64 KB. In comparison to existing methods, our proposed approach exhibits superior performance in terms of classification accuracy, particularly for smaller data lengths where the improvement is significantly more pronounced.

articleTitle: Wi-Move: Moving Object Detection Based on Fresnel Zone Model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Detecting moving objects is crucial in security, but current motion detectors are bulky and costly, limiting widespread deployment. In this paper, according to the Fresnel zone model and the difference in reflective power of different objects, the feasibility of detecting moving objects is proved theoretically, and a moving object detection system based on Channel State Information (CSI) is designed. The system proposes a threshold-based sliding variance and waveform truncation method to extract the object motion segment. A hybrid model utilizing Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) as the feature extraction layer and Support Vector Machine (SVM) as the classification layer is constructed. We carried objects at a constant speed by moving the slide and conducted numerous experiments with eight common types of objects. The experimental results demonstrate that the average accuracy of Wi-Move is 96.01% in 1m detection distance and can effectively recognize moving objects.

articleTitle: Development of a Self-Powered Speed Sensor for Drilling Tools with Multiple Friction Belts
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Drilling is a technique that uses drilling tools to drill holes from the surface to the underground, and it is an important means of mining solid minerals and oil and gas resources. Whether it is a screw drill or a turbine drill, the rotational speed is key data to determine the operating status of the drilling tool and the downhole conditions, so it is necessary to measure the rotational speed of the drilling tool in real-time. In this paper, a multi-friction belt drill speed sensor based on a triboelectric nanogenerator was developed. Its design is a parallel structure of multiple friction belts, and any one of the friction belts can independently measure the speed and generate electricity, thus having high power generation performance. Through the sensor performance test, it is found that the sensitivity of the speed sensor is 0.0167 Hz/rpm, the linearity is 2.7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, and the maximum relative error is 3.6%. By analyzing the output relationship of the sensor under different friction belts, it was found that the maximum output voltage of the speed sensor in a single friction belt structure is 18 V, the maximum output current is 1.5 uA, and the maximum output power of 12 uW is obtained when connected to an external <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{2.8}\times \mathbf{10}^{\mathbf{7}}\mathbf{\Omega}$</tex>. The output voltage of the multi-friction belt (n) drill speed sensor is consistent with that of the friction belt structure, while the output current and power are <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{n}$</tex> times that of the single friction belt structure. The sensor can maintain a high voltage output even in high-temperature and high-pressure environments, which can meet the needs of deep well speed monitoring.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Pseudo-Random Number Generator (PRNG) Using 2D Chaotic Mapping for Enhanced Randomness
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel two-dimensional chaotic mapping and leverages its properties to design an efficient Pseudo-Random Number Generator (PRNG). Chaotic mappings find widespread applications in cryptography, simulation, and random algorithms, playing a crucial role in enhancing randomness and ensuring data security. The proposed two-dimensional chaotic mapping combines two independent chaotic equations, achieving a more complex and diversified generation of random sequences. The paper provides a detailed description of the mathematical model of this mapping and analyzes its performance and statistical characteristics. Building upon the two-dimensional chaotic mapping, we design and implement a high-quality PRNG. This PRNG demonstrates significant improvements in randomness, uniformity, and periodicity compared to traditional PRNGs. We conduct thorough performance evaluations, including tests for randomness, distribution analysis, and periodicity detection. Experimental results indicate superior performance across various metrics compared to conventional PRNGs. We also discuss potential application areas for the proposed PRNG, such as encrypted communication, simulation experiments, and Monte Carlo simulations. Our research offers new insights into enhancing the quality and security of PRNGs, contributing significantly to the application of chaos theory in information security and computing.

articleTitle: Bi-Cubic Interpolation Image Scaling Algorithm Based on FPGA Implementation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Image resizing plays a very important role in image processing, offering good scalability and extensibility. Currently, there are some issues with existing scaling interpolation algorithms, such as complex hardware implementation, high resource consumption, long operation times, and poor realtime performance. To address these challenges, this paper introduces a design method based on the image bicubic interpolation scaling algorithm and optimizes the floating-point operation aspect of image processing. Utilizing the FPGA platform, a step-by-step scaling approach is employed, first performing vertical scaling and then horizontal scaling to achieve parallel processing. This design significantly improves scaling efficiency, and its feasibility is demonstrated through functional simulation.

articleTitle: DeepCatch: A New Testing Framework for Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: DNNs have achieved great success in many fields over the past decades, however, due to a number of problems that often occur with DNNs, there is a growing interest in systematic testing of DNNs. Researchers aim to identify additional corner cases for the model to enhance its robustness. Therefore, we designed DeepCatch, a white-box testing framework designed to perform better in finding corner cases. We designed comparative experiments in image categorization to demonstrate the advantages of DeepCatch, which can find more corner cases while these corner cases are distributed over more categories.

articleTitle: UAV Based Radionuclide Distribution Mapping Method
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: By summarizing counting rate-based mapping algorithms and Compton scattering mapping algorithms, we find that counting rate-based mapping algorithms do not take geometric factors into account and may produce wrong results. The counting rate of Compton scattering mapping algorithms is too low and cannot obtain the all-purpose peak information, which limits the application range. In this paper, a real-time mapping algorithm based on filtered backprojection of radioactive activity is designed. This algorithm improves the accuracy of prediction mapping, predicts the radioactive activity distribution of soil surface in real time, and enriches the application range. Moreover, it can be mounted on unmanned carrier platforms, such as drones and robot dogs, to provide decision-making information for path planning.

articleTitle: Application and Research of UAV Automatic Inspection and Positioning Control Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of excessive deflection of UAV patrol angle and make the layout of patrol nodes more in line with the actual positioning requirements, the automatic patrol positioning control technology of UAV based on machine vision is studied. According to the principle of patrol coordinate transformation, the forward kinematics equation and inverse kinematics equation of UAV are solved respectively, and the patrol nodes of UAV based on machine vision are grasped and processed. On this basis, the extracted feature points are used to estimate the numerical level of pose between frames, and combined with relevant data, the positioning authority of the control host for the UAV inspection curve is determined, and the design of automatic inspection positioning control method for UAV based on machine vision is realized. Experimental results show that, compared with the detection algorithm based on Cascade R-CNN, under the action of machine vision technology, the deflection degree of UAV patrol angle is really well controlled, which can make the layout of patrol nodes more in line with the actual positioning requirements.

articleTitle: A Multi-Layer Video Layer Coding Algorithm Based on SVC in MF-TDMA Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Multi Frequency-Time Division Multiple Access (MF-TDMA) is a multiple access scheme that has widespread use in multimedia satellite networks. Scalable Video Coding (SVC) could support video data rates transmission adaption in different network environment. This paper describes the video flown in typical tree-topology, and analyzes the transmission bandwidth limitations. a multilayer video layer coding algorithm is proposed to adapt multilevel video conference.

articleTitle: Research on Truck Queue Curve Following Control Method based on Trajectory Preview
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Given the problems that truck platoons are prone to rollover and loss of control when driving in curves under high-speed driving conditions, this paper proposes a curve-following control method for truck platoons based on trajectory preview. This method achieves stable following of the pilot vehicle through longitudinal and transverse decentralized control. In terms of lateral control, trajectory preview is used to adjust the driving trajectory of the following vehicle to maintain a stable relative position with the leading vehicle. In terms of longitudinal control, the fixed vehicle distance control strategy is used to achieve a stable following of the leading vehicle at the desired vehicle distance. Simulations were conducted under two working conditions of high-speed driving: directional circle and sinusoidal path. The results show that the following car can stably follow the position and orientation of the leading car at a fixed following distance of 50m while driving on a high-speed curve, and the longitudinal displacement deviation gradually decreases to [−0.1,0.1]m, and the lateral displacement deviation gradually decreases and oscillates stably within [−0.1,0.1]m.ined on the style sheet, as illustrated by the portions given in this document

articleTitle: Research on Lightweight Improvement of YOLOv8-based Fire Detection Model for Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In the field of fire detection, computational constraints and limited memory resources pose challenges for robots and edge-embedded devices. Furthermore, some lightweight models struggle with effectively detecting complex targets. To address these issues, this study proposes a lightweight enhancement for the YOLOv8 model. The approach involves replacing the original backbone network with EfficientNetV2 for feature extraction, incorporating weighted feature fusion, and introducing the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM). The improved model undergoes experimentation using a self-constructed dataset for fire detection. Results indicate a significant reduction in network parameters and model inference time compared to the original YOLOv8 model, accompanied by an increase in the processing frame rate. Moreover, the enhanced model demonstrates a 1.9% improvement in the map@50 metric and a 1.2 % enhancement in map@50-95. This affirms that the improved model not only ensures superior detection performance but is also well-suited for applications in embedded devices and edge computing scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Detection Algorithm for Lumbar Disc Herniation Based on FCOS
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Lumbar disc herniation is a common spinal disease, and its diagnosis and treatment usually rely on medical imaging technology. Traditional medical image diagnosis methods require high labor and time costs. This article proposes an object detection network based on FCOS to achieve automated detection of lumbar disc herniation. This network introduces the idea of group convolution and incorporates attention mechanisms. In addition, the Soft NMS algorithm was used in the inference stage to avoid the problem of target boxes being violently deleted. The method proposed in this article achieved a mAP of 0.661 on the MRI test set, which has higher accuracy compared to other networks. This method provides a feasible and effective solution for detecting lumbar disc herniation, which is expected to assist doctors in clinical diagnosis.

articleTitle: Multi-template-based Object Tracking via Occlusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Although object tracking methods are developing rapidly recently, their robustness to occlusion scenarios remains a fundamental problem. In this paper, we focus on single object tracking based on the widely-adopted Siamese network. In order to reduce the frames of lost target, we propose a multi-template based object tracking framework by detecting occlusions. Firstly, a multi-template design is introduced, which stores long-term target appearance in libraries, and updates current template by fusing the similarity-oriented short-term knowledge. Secondly, occlusion detected is applied to guide template updating. Both occlusion and template memories contribute to the insensitivity to the learning rate. We conduct extensive experiments on VOT2018 and VOT2019. The significant reduction of frames of lost target validates the overall effectiveness of our approach.

articleTitle: IVHC-DLIO: Incremental Voxels based Hybrid Coupled Direct LiDAR-Inertial Odometry
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper proposes an incremental voxels based hybrid coupled direct LiDAR-inertial odometry (IVHC-DLIO) algorithm. The hybrid coupling approach combines the advantages of loosely coupled and tightly coupled methods. On one hand, the incremental voxel-based mapping technique is employed, resembling a loosely coupled approach. The IVox-GICP solver leverages the easy maintenance and efficient k- NN search capability of incremental voxels to achieve incremental GICP point cloud registration for scan-to-map alignment. On the other hand, the factor graph is used to achieve the tightly coupled state optimization and the optimized state is then utilized for subsequent point cloud motion compensation and state propagation, thereby enhancing mapping accuracy. The proposed method is evaluated on various public datasets, demonstrating excellent performance in terms of robustness, localization accuracy, and runtime.

articleTitle: Partial Discharge Fault Identification Method for Switchgear Driven by Multiple Types of Fault Information
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The partial discharge fault identification method driven by multiple types of fault information is of great significance for improving the accuracy and fault tolerance of fault identification. In this paper, typical partial discharge types in switchgear are identified, and four typical partial discharge models (corona discharge, surface discharge, floating discharge, and air gap discharge) are set up. Ultrasonic (Ultra) method, very-ultra-high frequency (V-UHF) method, and pulse current method (PCM) are used to collect partial discharge signals generated by different discharge types. First, the deep convolution neural network (CNN) algorithm is used to train the measurement data of different sensors, and then the Dempster Shafer (D-S) evidence theory is used to fuse the recognition results of multidimensional information sources, and the final decision is made. The results show that compared to the fault identification mode based on a single information source, the fault identification mode based on multidimensional information sources has higher accuracy and can correctly identify the discharge type even when one of the multidimensional information sources makes a false judgment, with better fault tolerance and better recognition effect.

articleTitle: Channel Estimation Based on Improved Compressed Sensing Algorithm with Reconfigurable Intelligence Surface Assistance
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of cascade channel estimation for Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface (RIS) assisted wireless communication systems, an improved Compressive Sensing (CS) algorithm based on double-structure sparsity is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the double-structure sparsity characteristic of cascade channel in RIS assisted wireless communication system is studied. Then, aiming at the problem that base station (BS) and users cannot obtain channel sparsity before channel estimation, an improved compressed sensing algorithm is proposed. Simulation results show that the algorithm proposed in this paper can solve the problem of unknown channel sparsity. It is more practical than other compressed sensing algorithms without relying on complete prior information.

articleTitle: A Multi Hypothesis Data Association Algorithm Based on Bi-GRU
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In radar multi-target tracking technology, data association is used to solve the problem of matching measurements with targets. Traditional association algorithms can be divided into single hypothesis and multi-hypothesis algorithms. When many echoes fall within the same wave gate, it is difficult for single hypothesis algorithms to correctly discriminate the sources of each measurement. Multi-hypothesis algorithms sacrifice computation for association correctness, making them unsuitable for tracking tasks with high realtime requirements. To address these issues, this paper proposes a novel association algorithm based on the Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit (Bi-GRU) framework, and redefines the generation principles of the confirmation matrix. The simulation results demonstrate that this approach, compared to traditional association algorithms, can handle common ambiguities and uncertainties in measurement allocation more effectively, achieve higher association accuracy and smaller filtering error.

articleTitle: Application of Deep Learning Based Longitudinal Tear Detection in Intelligent Main Transportation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The current traditional device for detecting longitudinal tearing of belts has a low level of intelligence, and the triggering mechanism is inherently prone to missed and false detections. This paper designs a longitudinal tear detection system based on deep learning, which takes YOLOv5s model as the deep learning model and low power consumption edge computing module as the carrier. The industrial intrinsic safety camera is used to obtain the image, which is transferred to the edge computing module for tear feature detection. The longitudinal tear length is calculated by fusing the belt speed sensor data, and only the external detection results are finally output. When the detected longitudinal tear length exceeds a certain threshold, the belt conveyor collaborative controller will control the sound and light alarm to give an alarm, and at the same time issue a shutdown command to the specific single controller. In addition, the edge computing module uploads the video stream and alarm data after image processing to the control platform for reference. This system deepens the intelligence level of longitudinal tear detection for the main conveyor belt in coal mines, ensures the safety of the coal production process, improves production efficiency, and reduces economic losses.

articleTitle: Current Signal Enhancement of High Voltage Circuit Breaker Based on W-CGAN-GP Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The availability of extensive sample data ensures the training effectiveness, although deep learning could significantly enhance the accuracy of the fault diagnosis, potentially. For fault diagnosis, the application of deep learning is hampered in the case of High-Voltage Circuit Breakers (HCVBs) as a result of the insufficient fault signals. To address this limitation, this paper introduces a variant of the generative adversarial network (W-CGAN-GP) tailored for enhancing fault electrical signals. The proposed method generates electrical signals corresponding to various fault conditions, thereby expanding the training dataset. To validate the efficacy of the approach in enhancing the fault diagnosis accuracy of HVCB, a comparative analysis of fault diagnosis accuracy was conducted before and after data generation. The experimental findings demonstrate that the fault signals generated by the method exhibit a high degree of similarity, leading to an improvement in fault diagnosis accuracy.

articleTitle: Butterfly Contour Extraction Based on Video Stream
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Bionic butterfly aircraft is one of important micro-aircrafts, which has attracted more attentions. Butterfly contour is very important for bionic aircraft design. Aiming at the difficulty of obtaining butterfly contour, this paper focuses on a butterfly contour extraction method based on butterfly flight video stream. There are many methods for extracting target contour. However, no general method exists for most applications. Therefore, different methods are tried to decide which ones are more appropriate. Firstly, an extraction process is proposed in this paper. Then, noise reduction is carried out by combining bilateral filtering and morphological open operation. The filtering results show that the combination of bilateral filtering and morphological opening operation is reasonable. Meanwhile, the contour extraction is discussed in detail. Combination of Sobel algorithm and maximum entropy is proposed and realizes the effective separation of butterfly target and complex background. Experiments show that the proposed image denoising and contour extraction method is reasonable and effective.

articleTitle: Design of Multi-Layer Information Security Protection Scheme for Vehicle-to-Grid System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Vehicle-to-grid(V2G) is an important tool for enhancing the flexibility of new power systems and ensuring real-time power balance. The V2G system has the characteristics of multiple levels of entities and strong openness, making it easy to become the main target and springboard for attacking the power grid. In this context, the article analyzes the communication architecture and potential information security risks of the V2G system. Based on the domestic password algorithm system, a multi-layer and full link V2G system information security protection architecture is constructed, which ensures the safe and reliable transmission of V2G system information through four key technologies: identity authentication, encryption protection, situational awareness, and data sharing. Through testing, it has been shown that in order to ensure the success rate of data encryption and decryption in the V2G system, the system must have a concurrency of less than 1000 times. The encryption and decryption time, throughput, and anomaly rate indicators of the system are excellent. This data scheme can meet the interactive business needs of the V2G and provide important guidance for the information security construction of V2G networks.

articleTitle: Noise Reduction Method for Long Period Magnetotelluric Signals Based on VMD-Wavelet Thresholding
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This article proposes a noise reduction method for long-period magnetotelluric (MT) data that combines Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) with wavelet thresholding (WT). Firstly, the signal is decomposed and combined with correlation coefficients to screen component signals. Then, the outliers of the component signals are identified and replaced using the median absolute deviation. The filtered component signals are denoised and reconstructed using wavelet thresholding to obtain denoised magnetotelluric signals.

articleTitle: Low Resolution Face Recognition Based on Contrast Representa Distillation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Face recognition is a challenging problem in computer vision, but most mature face recognition algorithms focus on the high resolution (HR) case and suffer from severe performance degradation at Low-resolution (LR), owing to the difficulty for getting information. In this paper, we propose a training method based on contrast representation distillation (CRD). The proposed method firstly feeds the features extracted from the HR and LR into two linear layers, allowing both of them to be mapped into a uniform space. Based on the idea of contrast learning, the cosine similarity is used as a loss to increase the similarity of the same person at different resolutions and decrease the similarity of different people. Experiments on real and simulated datasets with different resolutions have been used to verify the effectiveness of the method, all experimental results achieved SOTA.

articleTitle: Application Research of Xception-LSTM Multimodal Neural Network in Intelligent Prediction System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The intelligent control in traditional smart agriculture systems is mainly based on agricultural environmental information collected in real-time by sensors. Thresholds are set based on this information to achieve intelligent control through linkage actions of actuators. However, such systems are unable to provide the necessary functionalities for operation prediction and expert systems, which are crucial in modern digital agriculture. This paper proposes an innovative approach by introducing computer vision technology, constructing a joint neural network model (Xception-LSTM) that takes multimodal inputs including visual image data and sensor data. The Xception model is pre-trained to optimize the number of image data parameters, and the LASSO regression is utilized for feature selection of agricultural environmental factors, retaining strongly correlated factors such as indoor temperature and illumination. The features generated by Xception and LSTM are fused using neural network attention mechanism, and a fully connected layer is constructed to achieve accurate prediction of agricultural environmental factors. The model is tested on the Jetson- Nano platform, integrated with the agricultural prediction system using STM32, to realize agricultural operation prediction and ensure the scientificity of agricultural cultivation. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model outperforms other four types of prediction models in terms of MAE, MAPE, and RMSLE indicators, indicating its excellent performance.

articleTitle: Research on UAV Multi-Objective Path Planning Problem Based on Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper aims to investigate the inspection techniques for new unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in emergency rescue and disaster relief, with a focus on disaster assessment. Firstly, we mesh the target area and establish a multi-objective programming model to increase the coverage of the patrol area and reduce the number of UAVs. By applying the k-means + + algorithm, the original multi-UAV multi-target problem is transformed into a single UAV multi-target problem. Then, the improved Dijkstra algorithm and ant colony algorithm are used to solve this problem, and the minimum number of drones and flight routes are obtained. The case analysis results show that the coverage rate of this method reaches 91.84 %, and only 19 UAVs are needed, which has certain reference value.

articleTitle: Transmission Corridor Cleaning Operation Area Identification Based on Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of scene complexity, diverse target types and multi-scale leading to the difficulty of intelligent safety detection in scene engineering accounting work, this paper proposes an improved algorithm based on YOLOv5. Firstly, the YOLOv5 detection network is constructed and the SimAM attention mechanism is integrated under this framework; then, TSCODE is combined in the output detection header of the model to enhance the sensory field of the model; finally, this paper further verifies the effectiveness of the model improvement by taking a tree stump as the detection object. The experimental results show that the improved YOLOv5 model improves 3.1% and the mAP50 can reach 88.6%, which can effectively meet the requirements of detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Spearman-Coefficient-Based Improved D-S Evidence Theory Algorithm Considering the Initial Importance of Evidence Body and Its Application on Multi-Source Information Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Decision-making technology based on multi-source information fusion plays an increasingly important role in the field of R&D, design and manufacturing in digital-intelligence industry at the present time. Dempster-Shafer (D-S) evidence theory is a method that can effectively integrate multiple sources of information, conduct uncertainty reasoning and support decision making. How to carry out information fusion under the condition of evidence body conflict is the key to the effective application of D-S evidence theory. Moreover, due to the different sources of evidence, the initial importance of each evidence body is also a necessary concern prerequisite for the effective application of D-S evidence theory in real-world decision-making problems. In this paper, we propose an improved D-S evidence theory algorithm based on Spearman correlation analysis. According to the importance of each evidence body, the basic probability assignment (BPA) of D-S evidence theory is revised firstly. Then, based on the correlation of the evidence bodies in the same recognition framework, Spearman correlation coefficient is used to further modify the weight of evidence bodies. Finally, the modified evidence bodies are fused based on the improved evidence combination rule, thus the inference result is obtained. The method proposed in this paper is compared with several existing improved D-S evidence theory algorithms, and the numerical case results show that the proposed method is more robust in obtaining results aligning with common sense. The application results of a reliability prediction case for a new type of armored vehicle show that, for taking the initial importance of each evidence body into account, the proposed method can lead us to a decision that more in line with intuition and field test results compared with other existing improved methods.

articleTitle: FEB-YOLOv8: A Steel Surface Defect Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv8s
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of low recognition accuracy, many model parameters and large computation in the current steel surface defect detection algorithms. This paper proposes a steel strip surface defect detection algorithm based on improved YOLOv8s, called FEB-YOLOv8. Firstly, a new partial convolution is used to improve the C2f structure, which is able to effectively reduce the latency and reduce the model parameters. Secondly, an EMA attention mechanism is introduced into the end of the backbone network, which further enhances the feature extraction capability by encoding global information. Finally, a simplified version of BiFPN feature fusion is used to improve the model's ability to detect multi-scale defects. Experimental results show that compared with YOLOv8s, FEB-YOLOv8 increases mAP by 4.7% on the GC10-DET dataset, reduces the number of model parameters by 12.98<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, and reduces the number of floating point operations (FLOPs) by 14.58%, achieving a balance between algorithm detection accuracy and model parameters.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of High Frequency Passive Bistatic Radar Energy Exposure Range Estimation Based on Watershed Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The High Frequency Passive Bistatic Radar (HFPBR) is a typical two-base radar system in which the receiving station, the transmitting station and the detection area are located at long distances from each other. Since this radar system does not emit signals itself, it is necessary to obtain information about the range of the active source irradiation. In this paper, the received ground-sea clutter data are analyzed to obtain the representation of clutter energy in the distance-azimuth two-dimensional spectrogram. Then, the watershed algorithm in mathematical morphology is used to smooth and binarize the clutter energy matrix, so as to correct and estimate the irradiation coverage of the exogenous energy. The experimental results are highly consistent with the measured data, verifying the validity and accuracy of the proposed methodology.

articleTitle: Pose Estimation Method of Maintainability Test Components Based on PVNet
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In order to construct the virtual-real fusion maintainability test scenario and human-machine interaction mechanism, it is necessary to obtain real-time pose information of components. Therefore, an improved PVNet based component pose estimation algorithm was deeply studied, and the improved ResNet18 was used as the main backbone network to obtain the feature map. In the subsequent processing of the feature map, ELU activation function is used instead of LeakyReLU activation function in the original module. Compared with LeakyReLU, ELU is smoother and can handle complex data sets and deep networks. The experimental results show that the improved algorithm achieves a good effect on the self-made Linemod format air filter cover data set, in which the accuracy of 2D mapping index reaches 91.84%, the accuracy of ADD index reaches 86.69%, and the accuracy of 5cm5° reaches 94.73%, effectively improving the accuracy of real-time pose estimation and virtual reconstruction.

articleTitle: Vehicle Multi-channel CAN Data Acquisition Based on Lock-free FIFO Queue
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Because there are many nodes on the vehicle CAN bus and the bus load rate is large, it is easy to overflow the CAN controller's receiving mailbox and cause frame loss. To solve this problem, a multi-channel CAN data acquisition system is designed based on unlocked FIFO queue algorithm. The software part uses the unlocked FIFO queue algorithm to create a ring FIFO queue for each CAN, and can automatically adjust the queue length according to the current bus load. In the hardware part, STM32 is used as the main control chip, the first three of the eight CAN channels use the MCU's own CAN controller, and the last five channels use the external extended SPI to CAN controller, using SD card as the storage module. The multi-channel data acquisition instrument is realized. The results show that the algorithm can effectively reduce frame loss and improve the efficiency of data acquisition.

articleTitle: HR-UXNet: A High-Resolution Model for Brain Tumor Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Semantic segmentation of brain tumors is a fundamental task in medical image analysis, involving multiple MRI modalities for diagnosing patients and studying malignant tumor progression.
