With the advancements in CNN and Transformer algorithms, recent 3D medical segmentation models, like VT-UNET, have achieved state-of-the-art performance in the BraTS brain tumor dataset. The majority of networks used for brain tumor semantic segmentation currently employ the U-Net architecture. While U-Net-like architectures offer rich contextual information, the process of recovering high-resolution representations from low-resolution ones may reduce the spatial accuracy of the resulting segmentation masks. In previous works, the design style of High-Resolution Network (HRNet) has been successfully applied to various 2D image segmentation tasks, such as human pose estimation, scene segmentation, and object segmentation. HRNet focuses on feature fusion between low-resolution and high-resolution representations, rather than aiming to recover high-resolution information from low-resolution ones. This approach is highly relevant for complex brain tumor segmentation tasks. Thus, in this paper, we introduce, for the first time, the utilization of the HRNet design style in the context of brain tumor segmentation. We employ the 3D UX-Net block to exchange information between feature maps of different resolutions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that on the BraTS 2021 dataset, the performance of HR-UXNet is comparable to advanced U-Net based models in brain tumor segmentation.

articleTitle: Research on Semantic Segmentation Method for Maritime Navigation Scene Based on Improved DMNet
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In recent years, semantic segmentation has been continuously developing, but there are still problems such as incomplete image understanding, incomplete contextual information extraction, imbalanced data samples, and uneven object distribution. A semantic segmentation algorithm based on an improved Dynamic Multi scale Network (DMNet) is proposed to address the current issues. An attention mechanism is added to the decoder to make the network pay more attention to the target to be detected; Using online difficult sample mining to improve the problem of sample imbalance in the dataset; Utilize the CrossEntropyLoss+Lovasz SoftmaxLoss joint loss function and the Adam with decoupled weight Decay (AdamW) optimizer to improve network training effectiveness and segmentation accuracy. The algorithm achieves 85.01% mIoU and 90.30% mAcc, effectively optimizing the model structure and improving segmentation accuracy, thus providing a certain technical foundation and application reference for semantic understanding of maritime channel scenes.

articleTitle: Speech Emotion Recognition Based on 1D-CNNs-LSTM Hybrid Model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Speech emotion recognition is a key technology for achieving human-computer interaction. Implementing efficient emotion classification has always been a research topic for researchers. In response to the problem of weak representation of local feature information extracted from the original speech segments, and considering the complexity of manually extracting features, in order to learn the best feature representation from the original speech segments and extract contextual information from cumbersome speech segments, a 1D convolutional neural networks long short-term memory (ID-CNNs-LSTM) neural network model has been proposed. The two Local feature enhancement block (LFEB) modules in the new model further enhance local feature information, improve data expression ability and classification performance. The LSTM module can effectively extract contextual information from speech segments, which helps to improve the accuracy of the model. The new model can automatically extract features from original speech segments and has the advantages of small parameter size, easy training, and low computational complexity, makes it more suitable for low-power and low memory devices. The new model was tested on the Berlin EMODB dataset and achieved an optimal classification accuracy of 94.49%, which is 2.47% higher than the 2D CNN model, verifying the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Research on UAV Tracking Control Method Based on Guidance Law
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: For the UAV maneuver target tracking problem, the UAV motion is decomposed into along the line-of-sight direction and vertical line-of-sight direction, the airborne maneuver target tracking guidance law is designed according to the requirements of the rendezvous process, and the two-loop overload autopilot is designed to track the overload command generated by the guidance law. The UAV maneuver target is simulated, and the simulation results show that the use of the UAV can produce adaptive maneuver to the maneuver target and can accurately track the target, proving the effectiveness of the guidance law proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Method of Engineering Vehicles for Variable Working Condition Based on a Multi-Source Transfer Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The accuracy of fault diagnosis for engineering vehicles will decrease if the fault model is established by using traditional methods when the working conditions change. For the variable working conditions, it is not practical to build one fault model for each working condition. Therefore, a fault diagnosis method for engineering vehicles based on a multi-source transfer neural network algorithm is proposed. The proposed method is based on the convolutional neural network model and adds the framework of multi-source transfer learning, the output of the fully connected layer of the neural network is used as the input of multi-source transfer learning to calculate the inter-domain distance under multi-conditions, which is then added to the total loss to participate in the calculation of the network parameters. To validate the feasibility of the proposed method, two datasets were used to conduct the study. The first type of dataset is the bearing vibration data under three types of working conditions, with 8800 samples for each type, and the second type of dataset is the bearing vibration data under four types of working conditions, with 1683 samples for each type. The experimental results of classification accuracy show that compared with CNN and SVM methods, in the first type of data analysis, the average accuracy of the proposed method is improved by 1.95% and 48.57%, respectively; in the second type of data analysis, the average accuracy of the proposed method is improved by 3.17% and 26.39%, respectively. The proposed method requires only training data under limited working conditions to establish a fault analysis model, which can test the fault types under other unknown working conditions. The proposed method provides a feasible and effective method for fault diagnosis of engineering vehicles in extreme environments with variable working conditions.

articleTitle: Design of 425 GHz Sub-Harmonic Mixer
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The terahertz receiver system has the characteristics of wide-band detection, and has a wide application prospect in the fields of space communication, meteorology research, inspection and detection. The development of superheterodyne receiver has certain advantages in the higher frequency band of terahertz. And the second harmonic mixer is the most widely used, with a good compromise effect. Based on the mature quartz circuit and shielded cavity processing technology, a 425 GHz sub-harmonic mixer is designed. The mixer is designed with anti-parallel Schottky diode with anode area of 0.64 μm2 to achieve lower junction capacitance and higher cut-off frequency. The circuit adopts the combination of microstrip line and suspended microstrip line, which not only realizes the good support of the circuit, but also reduces the loss caused by the dielectric substrate. The 425 GHz sub-harmonic mixer structure adopts the matching mode of four impedance lines to simplify the circuit structure. The overall circuit length is 3.069 mm.

articleTitle: Anti Occlusion Improvement of Kernel Correlation Filter Target Tracking Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper proposes a target tracking algorithm that combines kernelized correlation filter (KCF) and Kalman filter (KF) prediction to address the problem of poor tracking performance or even failure in target tracking when the target is occluded. This article uses peak sidelobe ratio to determine whether the target is occluded. When the target is unobstructed or partially occluded, the learning rate is optimized to update the target appearance model; When the target is severely occluded, stop updating the KCF model and use the Kalman filtering algorithm to predict the trajectory of the moving target to estimate its position at this time. This article uses the OTB100 dataset for experiments, and the results show that the improved KCF (KCF-A) target tracking algorithm has improved accuracy and success rate. Compared with other target tracking algorithms, its tracking accuracy and success rate are better, and it can achieve better tracking performance when the target is occluded, effectively improving the algorithm's anti occlusion ability.

articleTitle: Integrated Flexible Job Shop Scheduling and Machine Layout Problem Considering Mixed Transportation Ways
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Despite of the close relationship between machine layout and job scheduling, the existing researches usually treat them separately. Hence, this paper proposes an integrated flexible job shop scheduling and machine layout problem considering mixed transportation ways (ISLPMT). Then, a novel multiobjective mixed-integer nonlinear programming model is presented to minimize makespan and total material flow cost simultaneously. And a hybrid genetic algorithm based on critical neighborhood search (HGACNS) is designed to solve it. In the HGACNS, two different critical neighborhood searches, i.e., critical machine neighborhood search and critical path neighborhood search, are developed to improve the algorithm performance. Experiments are carried out to verify the feasibility and performance of the proposed model and algorithm. The results indicate that the HGACNS is superior to other comparison algorithms.

articleTitle: Design of S-Band RF Broadband Power Amplifier Based on Chebyshev Low-Pass Filter and Dual-Band Matched Structure
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In this work, a broadbanded RF power amplifier based on Chebyshev filter and dual-band matching is developed. It operates within the range of 3.0-4.0 GHz in the S-band, and the amplifier tube is CGH40010F provided by Cree. The bias circuit consists of a filter capacitor and a low-pass filter, which can isolate the ac and de circuits in a wider bandwidth range; the input matching network utilizes the filter characteristics of the filter to perform the impedance transformation, which can reduce the return loss; the output matching network uses a The output matching network uses dual-frequency matching, which can effectively expand the frequency band. The bias isolation of the amplifier is over 100dB, the overall return loss is below -10dB, the output power is 37.2dbm at the 1dB compression point, the power added efficiency is 50%, and the gain is 12.2dB.

articleTitle: A Deep Survival Prediction Model for NSCLC Patients Based on MSPP-CNN and RNN
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) is a major subtype of lung cancer and accounts for a large proportion of cancer deaths worldwide. Diagnostic delay and poor prognosis are key factors leading to death. To help prognostic decision-making in clinical practice for medical experts and improve the survival prediction accuracy, this paper proposes a deep learning model which integrates convolutional neural networks (CNNs) with Multi-Scale Pyramid Pooling (MSPP) and a recurrent neural network (RNN). It uses serial CT imaging to evaluate the health status and predict the survival of patients with NSCLC. The proposed model is trained on the data of 575 NSCLC patients from a local hospital and is tested on the data of 200 NSCLC patients from an outside hospital. The proposed model achieved the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) value of 0.81 and F1-score of 0.77 on 575 training samples which performed best when compared with other models. Furthermore, on 200 testing samples, the model achieved the AUC of 0.78 and F1-score of 0.75.

articleTitle: Multi-Period Tobacco Plant Identification Based on Drone Image and Improved Yolov7 Model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Taking Pingdingshan and Xuchang areas as an example, an improved YOLOv7 model was used to accurately and dynamically identify the number of tobacco plants based on the tobacco images obtained by UAV during the flourishing period and early maturity period. The results show that after adding Focus to MPConv module, introducing SimAM parameterless attention mechanism and improving it with WIoU loss function, YOLOv7 model has faster convergence speed and better generalization performance during training. The average accuracy rate, recall rate and accuracy rate of tobacco plant number identification reached 98.62%, 97.20% and 92.85%, respectively, which were increased by 0.32%,1.52% and 0.85% compared with the original model, and the F1-score reached 0.95, 1% higher than that of the original model, which was better than YOLOv5 and YOLOv4. Traditional target detection models such as SSD and Faster-RCNN and YOLOv4+CBAM models; The identification accuracy of the improved YOLOv7 model was 99.3%, 99.0% and 98.7% for the number of tobacco plants from the cluster planting stage to the early mature stage, and the identification effect was the best in the flourishing period.

articleTitle: Development of a High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound (HIFU) Treatment System: Integrating STM32G474 Microcontroller and GaN Power Devices for Precise Tissue Targeting and Remote Control
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: High-intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) treatment system, as a non-invasive therapy technology, uses the ultrasonic waves generated by ultrasonic transducers to form thermal damage to the focus area through external emission and internal treatment [1]. When the energy of the focused sound wave is high enough, the diseased tissue undergoes thermal necrosis, resulting in cell death. Currently, it has been widely used in the treatment of uterine fibroids in China [2]. This paper presents a proposed solution: using a single or dual chips to drive the annular transducer to focus the ultrasound on the target area, thus achieving the inactivation of diseased tissue. The system uses the STM32G474 as the main control chip and GaN [3] as the external driving power device [4]. It combines a LCD screen and a graphical user interface and is controlled in combination with peripheral devices to enable the main control board to independently adjust the PWM signal. At the same time, this design also implements communication between the upper and lower computers to achieve remote control. Finally, it is preliminarily verified by experiments that the four waveforms generated by the main control meet the full-bridge excitation standard in the normal frequency range. And also, the waveforms of the full-bridge output under different power supply voltages are tested when the PWM frequency is controlled. Furthermore, the synthesized electric power and sound power output by the full bridge under different power supply voltages are tested when PWM frequency is controlled, which can basically achieve ideal results.

articleTitle: Cable Defect Detection Based on Terahertz Time-Domain Spectroscopy Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Cables have good insulation performance, small footprint, and high transmission safety, making them an important component of China's power transmission and transformation system. If cables are damaged or broken due to certain factors, it often leads to power outages in a certain area. Therefore, analyzing the causes of cable faults and making accurate judgments can accelerate the monitoring and prevention of faults, and reduce open circuit losses. The use of terahertz technology can perform non-destructive testing on the interior of cables, but the direct imaging results of terahertz systems have problems such as large size, unclear, poor quality, low contrast, and noise. In this article, wavelet denoising is used to process the image, and the results show that wavelet denoising can effectively remove noise and improve image contrast. Terahertz technology can provide a new approach for cable defect detection and improve the accuracy of defect detection.

articleTitle: Research on Islanding Mechanism and Anti-Islanding Method of Doubly-Fed Wind Turbines
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Through the analysis of the islanding operation characteristics of wind turbines, the relationship between the power mismatch of wind turbine islanding operation and the voltage and frequency at the common connection points was revealed, and the power disturbance sensitivity was quantitatively analyzed. A comprehensive power island detection method was proposed, and the design of a comprehensive power disturbance island detection control loop for doubly-fed wind turbines was carried out. The method proposed in this paper has the characteristics of wider detection range, faster detection speed and higher reliability. The whole process of comprehensive power disturbance island detection of doubly-fed wind turbines is realized by MATLAB simulation, and the results show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Denoising Method Based on Improved VMD-Wavelet Threshold and its Application to Rolling Mill Vibration Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Steel is the lifeblood of the nation, and rolling mill are crucial for steel production. Therefore, it is necessary to monitor rolling mill. The aim of this study is to achieve accurate monitoring of rolling mill vibrations in the presence of noise. This paper utilizes an accelerometer sensor to design a rolling mill vibration signal acquisition device and proposes an improved denoising method that combines variational mode decomposition (VMD) with enhanced wavelet thresholding. The improved coati optimization algorithm is used to optimize the optimal number of decomposition layers and penalty factor for the VMD, enhancing the decomposition performance. Enhanced wavelet threshold function solves the shortcomings of discontinuity and distortion of wavelet denoising methods. The improved joint denoising method is compared with other methods. The experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively reduce the noise of the rolling mill vibration signal and improve the accuracy of the vibration monitoring device, which has good practical application value.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of User Side Energy Storage Based on Equivalent Aggregation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In response to the problem of user side energy storage (USES) not being able to directly participate in grid side regulation, the resource aggregator is introduced in this paper. Firstly, a USES aggregation model based on the resource aggregator is proposed, which effectively aggregates multiple USES to form an equivalent flexible distributed energy storage (ELDES) for system configuration. Next, in order to optimize the active network loss (ANL) of the distribution network (DN), a method based on the standard deviation of ANL sensitivity is proposed to fix the optimal access point for ELDES. Taking the network losses and daily revenue of the resource aggregator as the objective function, the priority order of FLDES access at each node of DN is determined. Finally, simulation results show that ELDES aggregated by the method proposed in this paper can not only enable USES to participate in the grid side dispatching, but also flexibly cooperate with the distributed energy storage to realize the local power balance, reduce the ANL of DN and reduce voltage fluctuation of DN, and play the role of USES in the regulation of the distribution network.

Author Keywords: standard deviation of network loss sensitivity

articleTitle: Temperature Compensation Method of Accelerometer Based on the Mixture Kernel Functions Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Due to the requirements of engineering practice, inertial navigation system should operate over a wider temperature range, and the temperature will cause the output of inertial devices to drift. To minish the impact of temperature on the measurement accuracy of accelerometers in inertial navigation system, the support vector machine is used to fit and regress the scaling factor and bias of the accelerometer's temperature compensation model, and the Harris hawks optimization is applied to search for the optimal parameters of support vector machine and improve the performance of the support vector machine. Finally, the method was validated through physical temperature experiments on the accelerometer. The testing results indicated that the method raised in this paper realized effective temperature compensation. The output stability of the accelerometer is improved by an order of magnitude, which means that the method has practical engineering value.

articleTitle: An Agile Service Design Method for Network Automation and Zero-Touch Management
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the continuous access of massive data, devices, and emerging applications to the Internet, network complexity and network management are facing unprecedented challenges. Therefore, it is urgent to optimize network and service management through artificial intelligence technology, and Standards Development Organizations (SDO) put forward the standards for network automation and zero-touch management. The service design of the Product-Service-Resource (PSR) model discussed in the paper is one of the means of network automation and zero-touch management through decoupling networks and services hierarchically. The paper also introduces the method of automated service design that effectively reduces the development cycle and human errors, which is the basis for realizing a fully autonomous network.

articleTitle: Research on Stamping Control System of Fixed Hole Based on PLC
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This article provides further analysis on the design, layout, and working principle of the automatic punching snake vertebra fixed hole conveyor line, and conducts research on the system control of the automatic punching snake vertebra fixed hole conveyor line based on PLC. With the objective of achieving automatic operation of the punching conveyor line, a punching control system flow is established. The Siemens S7-1200 PLC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup> is selected, and the TIA Portal V16 software is used for program design and coding. The program structure is built to realize the sorting of snake vertebrae in a specific direction by the vibrating disk, the feeding of the guide rail by the straight vibrator, the separation of individual snake vertebrae by the feeding mechanism, and the feeding, material retrieval, and punching by the robotic arm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[2]</sup>. The analysis shows that the punching conveyor line can achieve manual/automatic operation and automatic alarm functions in the PLC control.

articleTitle: A Generalizability-Enhancing Method for Load Identification Based on Typical Sample Replay
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In recent years, the problem of source-load imbalance has come to light due to the proliferation of new energy sources connected to the grid, endangering the new power system's safety. Fortunately, load identification can help realize the promise of demand response by sensing detailed information about power use. However, existing load identification methods trained on new datasets suffer from catastrophic forgetting that the performance of the old datasets drops dramatically. Therefore, a generalizability-enhancing method for load identification based on typical sample replay is proposed. It extracts typical waveforms by density-based spatial clustering of applications with noise (DBSCAN) algorithm and updates them through the designed mechanism, adding typical samples during the training of streaming tasks to delay the forgetting of old knowledge. Three datasets are used to simulate the streaming tasks, and the adaptive weighted recurrence graph (AWRG) model is used as an example to illustrate the proposed method's ability to significantly reduce the attenuation of performance. The proposed method can boost the widespread application of load identification and provide a new idea for the research field.

articleTitle: KeySign: WiFi-Based Authentication Using Keystroke Signatures
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Authentication plays an important role in human-computer interaction. Personal Identification Number (PIN) is a commonly used method in authentication. However, PINs can be easily cracked, posing a threat to system security. Similar to fingerprints, irises, and faces, a user's keystroke signature is biologically unique and can be used as the authentication feature. In this paper, we propose the KeySign system, which records the user's keystroke through Channel State Information (CSI) in WiFi. The system consists of a transmitter and two receivers. We designed a four-branch Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to extract feature from the amplitude and phase dimensions of the dual-receiver CSI. The network finally generates a vector that records user's keystroke feature. Finally, with the designed Class Density User Detection (CDUD) algorithm, we can distinguish between legal and illegal users while further identifying the specific identity of the legal user. We collected keystroke data from 8 users on 5 different sets of PINs. The experimental results show that for the distinction between legal and illegal users, KeySign has an average accuracy of 90.83%, a false acceptance rate of 7.08%, and a false rejection rate of 13.33%. For the identification of legal users, the average accuracy is up to 97.22%.

articleTitle: Application and Development of Photoelectric Sensor in Smart Wearable Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the rapid development of technology, there has been an increasing number of smart devices in people's lives, such as smartphones, tablets, and smartwatches. Alongside the growing awareness of personal health, there is a greater demand for understanding one's own health status. However, specialized medical monitoring equipment is often bulky, limiting the mobility of the individuals being monitored. Additionally, the complexity of the data generated by such devices makes it difficult for non-medical professionals to interpret the information it reflects. In this context, smart wearable devices have emerged as a popular solution, with one of their main sensors being the photoplethysmography (PPG) sensor. This article will first introduce the detection principles of the PPG sensor and how to measure and analyze the data it provides. It will then discuss the current development status of PPG sensors in various industries. Finally, it will address the limitations of existing PPG sensors and propose future improvement directions. The research presented in this article contributes to the study and application of PPG sensors.

articleTitle: Simulation of Multilevel Depth Filtering of Energy Metering Information Under Dynamic Iterative Sampling
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The amount of data generated by power metering systems is huge and complex, including power consumption records, power quality parameters, equipment status, etc., so it is difficult to filter large-scale power metering data effectively. Therefore, a multilevel depth filtering method for energy metering information under dynamic iterative sampling is proposed and verified by simulation. Based on dynamic iterative sampling architecture, the characteristics of redundant points of energy metering information are obtained by sampling time series of energy metering information. Based on this, voltage anomaly data, current anomaly data, and power factor anomaly data are extracted. The mean-shift transfer function is established to realize multilevel depth filtering of redundant points of energy metering information. The experimental results show that under different learning rates and pretraining iterations, the filtering accuracy of the basic and new types of energy metering information is higher, and the application efficiency is higher.

articleTitle: Highway Traffic Flow Control Model and Simulation Based on Fuzzy Control
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of the scale of highways, the growing contradiction between traffic demand and capacity has become an undeniable societal issue. Preventing congestion on highways and improving the efficiency of road usage has always been a focal point of research in the field of highway traffic control. In order to enhance the traffic operating environment, this paper establishes a traffic flow control simulation model and designs a fuzzy control algorithm to simulate the traffic flow state on highways. Subsequently, a comparative analysis is conducted on the traffic states under different strategies, including no-control, ALINEA control, and fuzzy control. To further demonstrate the effectiveness of fuzzy control, this paper relies on real data from the Xibao Expressway to simulate the traffic flow under fuzzy control. The results indicate that under equivalent conditions, the fuzzy control method can achieve superior performance.

articleTitle: Research on Temperature Adaptive Control Method of Auxiliary Dialysis Equipment Based on RBF Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Aiming at the difficulties of slow heating rate, slow temperature response, easy to be affected by ambient temperature and low precision in the heating process of manual peritoneal dialysis auxiliary equipment, this paper deeply analyzes the heating control process of the equipment, designs a temperature adaptive control method of auxiliary dialysis equipment based on RBF neural network, and explores the efficient heating control system of auxiliary dialysis equipment. On the basis of collecting a large number of actual data in the heating process, the intelligent data processing algorithm is introduced. The RBF neural network algorithm is used to adaptively compensate the dialysate temperature, and the temperature detection value without compensation is compared. The temperature adaptive control method of auxiliary dialysis equipment based on RBF neural network can adjust the control parameters in real time and accurately, solve the problems of slow heating speed and low temperature accuracy caused by easy environmental impact and uneven heating in the heating process, and realize real-time accurate monitoring of dialysate temperature. The treatment accuracy reaches <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pm \mathbf{1}\ {{}^{\circ}\mathbf{C}}$</tex>, with high stability and heating efficiency. The temperature control effect is significantly improved, ensuring the safety and comfort of the product. It has significant application value for clinical treatment of peritoneal dialysis.

articleTitle: Research on Radar Emitter Identification Algorithm Based on Coupled Recurrent Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This article analyzes the operational characteristics of two deep learning algorithms, Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), and proposes a radar radiation source recognition method based on Coupled Recurrent Network (CRN). Its feasibility is verified through simulation experiments. When the signal-to-noise ratio of the test set signal is 3dB, the algorithm still has a recognition rate of 82.73% for the signal, while when the signal-to-noise ratio of the test set signal is greater than or equal to 5dB, the recognition rate of the algorithm for signals exceeds 94.70%.

articleTitle: Recommendation of Ultrasonic Flowmeter Failure Maintenance Based on a Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The global shift to green energy has highlighted natural gas as a key transitional energy source. However, the substantial volume of natural gas trade poses economic risks due to measurement errors. Conventional fault diagnosis methods lack interpretability, while knowledge graphs offer more interpretable results by integrating expert experiences. This paper proposes a knowledge graph-based approach for fault maintenance recommendation in ultrasonic flowmeters, an area with limited application of knowledge graph technology. The approach involves determining a knowledge graph ontology through expert experiences and using an LSTM model to extract entities and relationships from unstructured text. Case validation demonstrates the method's effectiveness through metrics such as accuracy and recall in entity and relationship extraction. Future integration of operational data with the knowledge graph could enable automated and intelligent monitoring of operational states and fault maintenance recommendation for ultrasonic flowmeters.

articleTitle: A Path Planning Method for Mobile Robots Based on Improved Bidirectional A* Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Global path planning is one of the key technologies in the field of mobile robots, and A* algorithm is a very common and efficient global path planning algorithm. Aiming at the problems of the traditional A* algorithm, such as too many redundant points, too many invalid inflection points, the planned path is not smooth enough and the search path efficiency is low, the method of improving one-way search to two-way search, expanding the search field and introducing smoothing function is studied. At the same time, the traditional 4-field and 8-field search is increased to 16-field search, which effectively reduces redundancy points, shorens path length, improves search efficiency and speeds up search. Then Bessel smoothing is used to smooth the planned path and make the robot move more smoothly. Finally, the simulation results and experimental data are analyzed, and the traditional A* algorithm and the improved bidirectional A* algorithm are compared to verify the effectiveness and significance of the improved algorithm.

articleTitle: RL-based Transmission Power Control Algorithm for Interference Minimization in UAV Swarms
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Advancements in embedded system technology and wireless communication have facilitated the extensive use of micro unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in civil and public service applications. Given their high survivability, broad coverage, efficient task execution, and significant autonomy, micro UAVs are assembled into a networked aerial robot system, termed as a UAV swarm, to undertake information gathering and control tasks. The pronounced mobility of these systems frequently leads to variations in the distance between the UAV node and its adjacent nodes, engendering a highly dynamic topology, altering link bandwidth, and interference. These phenomena can potentially degrade the performance and reliability of communication within the UAV swarm. Acknowledging that dependable communication is pivotal for UAV swarm control and coordination, this paper introduces an RL-based power control algorithm to mitigate interference among UAV nodes in a UAV swarm. Our approach dynamically modulates the transmission power level to maintain a high-quality wireless link within the UAV swarm. Simulation outcomes demonstrate that our method can enhance the network performance of the UAV swarm under highly dynamic topologies.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Model Integrating LSTM with GARCH Family Models for the Ozone Concentration Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: To capture the characteristics of nonlinearity, high noise and volatility of the O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> concentrations time series, some hybrid long short-term memory (LSTM) prediction models based on the GARCH family models (GARCH-LSTM) are proposed in this paper. The hourly air pollutant data and meteorological data of 9 monitoring stations in Shanghai are applied for model training and testing, and the models are compared with the LSTM, extreme gradient boosting (XGBOOST), support vector regression (SVR) and k-nearest neighbor (KNN) models. Experiment results show that our GE-LSTM model, a hybrid model combining the LSTM model with the GARCH model and EGARCH model, has the best prediction skills in terms of root mean square error and mean absolute error for the three-hour prediction tasks. The GE-LSTM model demonstrates outstanding performance in the O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> concentrations prediction.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Model of GA-K Means-BP Neural Network for Financial Risk Warning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the continuous development of computer technology, artificial intelligence has penetrated into various fields and guided corresponding innovations. This also leads to increasing competition in various fields, requiring corresponding participants to engage in technological innovation. In this context, machine learning tools are often used to mine data in order to obtain the hidden patterns behind a large amount of complex data. BP neural network, as an important machine learning tool, has been used by many scholars for related research. In the field of enterprise financial risk research, BP neural networks can also be used for financial risk warning. Therefore, this paper focuses on the application of BP neural network in enterprise financial crisis warning. In the research, this paper constructs a financial crisis warning model based on the K-means clustering and BP neural network, and achieved good warning effects. To further improve the early warning effect of the model, this paper further introduces genetic algorithm to optimize the BP neural network, and constructs a hybrid model of GA-K-means-BP neural network to predict enterprise financial crises. Meanwhile, based on the hybrid model, the research shows that the early warning effect can be improved by introducing new enterprise characteristic indicators.

articleTitle: Convergence Analysis of Different Categories of Gradient Descent Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the rapid development of neural network models, gradient descent as the most important optimization algorithm in neural network models has received extensive attention from academia. At present, neural network technology has been used in various fields, such as computer vision, natural language processing, and speech recognition. In recent years, many kinds of gradient descent algorithms have been proposed to improve existing algorithms, each with higher efficiency and a more stable model structure. This paper will summarize and analyze various gradient descent algorithms and focus on the convergence of various algorithms to find a better method and analyze the optimization ability of that algorithm.

articleTitle: A Temporal Network Community Detection Method Based on Steady Labels and Label Propagation SteadyProp (A Temporal Network Community Detection Algorithm with Steady Labels and Label Propagation)
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Accurate community detection is crucial for timely comprehension of network structures, understanding evolutionary patterns, and predicting future network behaviors. It greatly enhances applications in social network analysis, disease prediction, and treatment, among others. In temporal community detection algorithms, inert nodes within communities tend to persist within the same community across multiple time slices. In this paper, these nodes are assigned steady-state labels. Identifying and applying steady-state labeled nodes accelerates and smoothens the process of community detection. Thus, this paper introduces a rapid temporal network community detection approach based on steazdy-state labels and label propagation. By leveraging the propagation of steady-state labels at each time step, this method achieves faster temporal community partitioning, effectively enhancing the accuracy and smoothness of such partitions.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent DC Energy Measuring Device
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Nowadays, the traditional AC power supply system has been unable to meet the growing development needs, DC power supply system because of its high power efficiency, low line loss, better power supply stability and other advantages in electric vehicle charging stations, photovoltaic and wind power generation, rail transit and other fields have been widely used. In this paper, a DC energy measuring device based on Hall sensor is designed to measure and monitor the DC power generation of wind farms. The hardware and software design principle of the measuring device is discussed in detail. In the hardware part, the voltage and current sampling circuit, RS485 communication circuit, clock and memory circuit are analyzed. The software part analyzes the management module, the measurement module and the communication module.

articleTitle: Advancing Table Detection In Engineering Drawings Through Synthetic Data Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The digitization of engineering drawings via Table OCR has been pivotal in extracting tabular data, crucial for structured information in assembly diagrams. However, the intricate layout styles and varied table structures within these drawings present a challenge for accurate table detection. Existing methods lack adaptability and generality, compelling the need for a novel approach. This paper introduces a solution leveraging synthetic engineering drawing generation to create a diverse dataset. A material library, comprising figures, text, and tables extracted from genuine drawings, forms the basis. The synthetic drawing generation involves randomizing tables with varying structures and integrating them into a wrap-around layout. Using YOLO object detection models trained on this synthetic dataset, the study evaluates different training strategies. Results indicate the effectiveness of synthetic data in enhancing table detection, especially when combined with real data for model fine-tuning.

articleTitle: Detection of False Data Injection Attacks on Industrial Control Systems Based on Joint Analysis of Principal Components and Independent Components
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Industrial control systems are widely used in fields such as power, chemical, and petrochemical industries, playing a crucial role in ensuring production and livelihoods of people. However, the complex hierarchical structure and numerous controllable nodes of industrial control systems pose serious security challenges. In recent years, attacks on industrial control systems have been occurring frequently, causing significant damage to the safe operation of industrial production and even resulting in severe security incidents. For scenarios of false data injection attacks on industrial control systems in chemical field, the limitations of principal components analysis (PCA) anomaly detection for non-Gaussian data are analyzed. To address this issue, independent component analysis (ICA) method is introduced as a complementary method to extract independent components from non-Gaussian data. By combining the advantages of PCA and ICA, a joint detection method that integrates both has been proposed. In the proposed method, the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$T^{2}$</tex> statistic based on PCA, the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$T^{8}$</tex> statistic for the main part and the SPE statistic for the residual part based on ICA are combined to reconstruct a new unique joint detection indicator, the Bayesian inference criterion (BIC) detection indicator, by using the Bayesian probability. Finally, the Tennessee-Eastman (TE) process model is taken as the research object, and a simulation verification with injecting attacks with sine wave false data was conducted to validate the effectiveness of the proposed method. The result indicates that the proposed method has a good detection capability for the signal changes caused by the attacks.

articleTitle: Optimization Algorithm for the Hybrid Pickup and Delivery Problem with Time Windows for Electric Vehicles and Automatic Delivery Robots
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper presents the vehicle routing problem with simultaneous pickup and delivery and time windows for hybrid delivery of electric vehicles and automatic delivery robots (VRPPDTW-HEADR). Automatic delivery robots are deployed at service stations to assist electric vehicles for customer service. Electric vehicles considering charging en-route can service customers directly or handle goods at the service station to the automatic delivery robot. Simultaneous pickup and delivery services of customer-to-customer and depot-to-customer-to-depot are meticulously addressed. The problem is formulated as a mixed-integer programming model that minimizes the total cost to serve all customers. A novel hybrid metaheuristic algorithm is proposed to solve VRPPDTW-HEADR. Local search operators that fit the characteristics of the problem are customized. The performance of the proposed algorithm is tested on different scale instances. The numerical results show that it can obtain high quality solutions for all instances within a remarkably short runtime.

Author Keywords: Pickup and delivery problem with time windows

articleTitle: Exploring the Self-Organizing Mechanisms for Maintaining Stability in Multi-Agent Systems within Dynamic Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In the absence of external interference, independent multi-agent systems evolve over time, leading to a transition from an ordered to a chaotic state within the internal dynamics of the scene. To assist in maintaining the stability of dynamic systems, this paper explores the design and composition of the scenario. A category of altruistic agents with selfless attributes is introduced into the multi-agent environment, and the decentralized algorithm I-DDPG is employed to train these altruistic agents to perform tasks with altruistic tendencies. Weakly connected self-organization is used to enable cooperation among altruistic agents in addressing internal issues. The study demonstrates a positive correlation between the overall system stability and individual information entropy, as well as the method of obtaining individual altruistic rewards. To investigate the connection between overall scene stability and self-organization among internal individuals, a traffic scenario is constructed with both human-driven and autonomous vehicles. Autonomous vehicles (AVs) represent a type of altruistic agent, and experiments are conducted to explore the relationship between scene stability and internal self-organization among individuals. The study concludes that using I-DDPG improves the learning efficiency of agents compared to DDPG and demonstrates a higher safety level in stress tests. Post-training, agents utilizing weakly connected self-organization in scenarios involving merging and exiting obtain higher altruistic rewards. This approach aids human-driven vehicles in achieving their intended goals, contributing to an overall improvement in the stability of dynamic systems.

articleTitle: An adversarial text generation method at multiple granularity
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Adversarial samples pose significant challenges to machine learning models, highlighting the need for robust defenses. This paper presents a novel approach for studying the influence of adversarial samples on machine learning models by proposing a multi-granularity text adversarial sample attack method under the constraint of semantic similarity. The proposed method combines word substitution at the word level and a short text generation model at the sentence level to generate target samples. By incorporating semantic similarity limits and part-of-speech restrictions during the adversarial text generation process, the resulting adversarial text exhibits higher semantic similarity. Aiming at the problem of the exponential increase in computational demand brought about by the introduction of the genetic evolution algorithm, we propose a dynamic parameter adjustment method to achieve effective pruning of subclass target groups. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that the multi-granularity attack method outperforms existing techniques such as TextBugger, PWWS, VIPER, and others. It achieves higher success rates in generating adversarial samples while maintaining a higher degree of semantic similarity. This research contributes to advancing the understanding of adversarial attacks in the context of text-based machine learning models and provides insights into enhancing the robustness of such models against adversarial samples.

articleTitle: Mine Pressure Monitoring System Based on Automatic Acquisition of Working Face Feeds
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The existing mine pressure monitoring system has already realised online continuous monitoring of the working face stent resistance, roadway roof off-loading and anchor rod/rope working resistance. However, the mine pressure monitoring information of the working face is only the stent resistance and monitoring time, and there is no information on the working face advance. When analysing the mine pressure data, no accurate analysis can be made due to the lack of measurement point locations. Mine pressure data analysis combined with the working face progress information is the basis for improving the safe and efficient mining and intelligent level of the comprehensive mining working face. This system adopts UWB (Ultra-Wide Band) technology and SDS-TWR (Symmetric Double-Sided Two-Way Ranging) positioning algorithm, takes UWB positioning base station as the core, installs positioning tags in the working face end bracket for information collection, and uploads the data to the supremacy computer for coordinate solving via Ethernet. The data is uploaded to the host computer via Ethernet for coordinate solving, automatically collects the working face advancement data, and provides location information for mine pressure monitoring. The application results show that the system operates normally, and can collect real-time working face advance information and monitor mine pressure data with good application effect.

articleTitle: Research on Visibility Enhancement and Real-Time Evaluation Methods for Virtual Assembly
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In current virtual assembly operations, the positioning range of motion capture equipment is limited, which results in users being only allowed to obtain spatial information within a single perspective. For existing virtual assembly systems, there is a lack of real-time visibility evaluation standards. To increase the spatial information that users can obtain within a limited field of view, this paper establishes a hybrid auxiliary interface that integrates the central projection perspective and the three-view perspective. Meanwhile, this paper establishes a visual field model that conforms to the physiological characteristics of the human eye, analyzes the influencing factors of visibility evaluation, and proposes a visibility evaluation model that integrates five major influencing factors. Based on the above work, this paper builds an assembly scene and carries out the assembly test of the torque converter in the virtual environment. The results prove that without reducing visibility, the auxiliary interface helps users obtain more information and improves the performance of the virtual assembly system.

articleTitle: Rumor Detection Model with Deep Cross Fusion of Text and Propagation Graph Structures
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The generation and spread of rumors are phenomenon that cannot be eradicated in human society. However, the wanton spread of rumors will harm the development of society, especially in the current era of information. The existing rumor detection models or frameworks are basically based on deep neural networks, which can extract text and propagation features and other information aiding rumor assessment, and then combine these features to filter rumors. Although these methods are effective, it is difficult to distinguish rumors in complex contexts or instances where the signs of forgery are not so obvious. Therefore, based on the interactive characteristics of text content and Propagation graph structure, this research proposes a rumor detection model with deep cross fusion. First, the text content and the information of propagation graph structures are encoded while ensuring that they are complete and independent, thereby extracting important information; Then, the separately encoded text content is deeply cross fused with the propagation graph structures, so that the information can penetrate and complement each other, and at the same time, a self-attention operation is performed after the cross fusion of each layer. Finally, the encoding from both components is fully integrated, then a classification feature vector is introduced into the output result of each part, and the classification result is output after multiple layers of fully connected layers. The experiments on three classical rumor detection datasets show that the model has a significant improvement in both accuracy and specified delay time, and the maximum accuracy is improved by 1.21%.

articleTitle: A New Decision-Making Approach via Monte Carlo Tree Search and A2C
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) is a state-of-the-art algorithm suitable for decision-making problem in adversarial complex environments. In this paper, aimed at the challenge of search space being too huge, we lead importance sampling technology into MCTS and build a more efficient algorithm ImS-MCTS, which makes an improvement using probability mapping. Besides, we apply ImS-MCTS to the Advantage Actor-Critic (A2C) framework with deep learning to form a new decision-making approach. The critic uses neural network to approximate the state-value function; the actor is built based on ImS-MCTS, each expanded new leaf is evaluated by the output from neural network and the results of several Monte Carlo rollouts. An advantage function is defined to optimize the neural network, and neural network with updated parameters will significantly improve the strength of ImS-MCTS in the next iteration. The proposed approach has a wide generality in adversarial complex environments. We test our approach in the video game Assault from Atari 2600. Results prove that ImS-MCTS has better performance than traditional MCTS; the combination of A2C framework and deep learning can make the decision-making approach even stronger.

articleTitle: A Modelling Method of Aero-Engine Fuel System Based on Bond Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Based on the bond graph theory, a modular modelling method of the aero-engine fuel system is proposed. The basic components in the system are classified according to their mechanical hydraulic characteristics, and a bond graph model is established for each type of components. Modelling of concerned system is accomplished by integrating component models involved, simplifying the system's modelling process. With this method, the model of engine's fuel regulator is established as an example. This model is then transformed into a state space equation, simulated with MATLAB to prove the effectiveness of this modelling method.

articleTitle: Fast Correspondence Clustering by Cluster-Wise Spatial Compatibility for Point Cloud Registration
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Spatial compatibility (SC) is a widely used similarity measure in outlier rejection methods. However, the single compatibility check used in the spatial compatibility measure is vulnerable to problems such as feature ambiguity, resulting in inaccurate or even incorrect alignment. To solve this problem, we extend the common spatial compatibility measure to correspondence cluster and propose the cluster-wise spatial compatibility (CSC) measure, which eliminates outliers by performing multiple compatibility checks between correspondence clusters. Then, to better utilize the advantages of CSC measure, we design an innovative and efficient correspondence clustering strategy to group the initial correspondences into different clusters. Finally, we use weighted SVD algorithm to solve the rigid transformation from reliable clusters and select the best model as the result. Sufficient experiments show that our method achieves excellent performance in both outdoor and indoor scenes.

articleTitle: Hybrid Action Space D2D Resource Allocation Algorithm Based On Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: D2D (Device-to-Device) communication is one of the key technologies in 5G network. However, the resource allocation problem of D2D communication has become a bottleneck that affects network performance. This paper designs a multi-agent hybrid resource allocation algorithm (MHRA) for the channel and power allocation problem of D2D communication links while reusing uplink resources from the base station. The algorithm can handle both discrete channel allocation and continuous power allocation, and maximize network throughput while satisfying quality of service requirements. Each D2D link is modeled as an agent, and distributed reinforcement learning is performed based on the hybrid action space by sharing global state and immediate reward information. The paradigm of centralized training and distributed execution is used to improve algorithm performance. Simulation results show that the cumulative reward obtained by MHRA is better than that of the centralized DQN allocation algorithm under small-scale D2D networking, and MHRA is capable of solving larger scale D2D resource allocation problems. Compared with the distributed DQN algorithm, MHRA can significantly improve the cumulative reward, and has better stability and convergence speed.

articleTitle: Adaptive Selection of Cognitive Radar Waveforms Based on Improved Deep Q-Learning Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of traditional radar fixed waveform parameters to perform tasks that are vulnerable to reconnaissance, this paper combines deep Q-learning networks in deep reinforcement learning with a posteriori estimation of the target state and proposes a cognitive radar waveform adaptive selection model based on an improved Deep Q-leaning Network (DQN) strategy. The proposed method models the radar environment, designs a reward function based on the target entropy state, and uses the DQN to learn the reward expectation for the target to select different waveform parameter actions in the current state. The experiment results show that the improved DQN policy-based cognitive radar waveform adaptive selection scheme proposed in this paper achieves significant efficiency gains and is more practical than traditional heuristic algorithms.

articleTitle: Online Adaptive Prediction Method for Cloud Computing Workloads with Bi-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the increasing maturity and popularity of cloud computing technology, cloud applications in enterprises and individuals have become a significant trend in information technology. The efficient, stable, and economical operation of cloud computing environment poses a challenge to the industry. The accuracy of workload prediction is particularly critical, as it is directly related to rational deployment of resources, cost optimization, and system stability. Due to the unique characteristics of cloud computing environments, including its huge scale, resource-sharing mechanism, multi-tenant architecture, and diversity of application types, it is difficult for traditional prediction models to adapt to its dynamic and complex load change patterns. This study proposes an innovative deep-learning model to address the above challenges to predict resource loads in cloud computing environments. The model first performs a deep feature extraction on historical load data. Then, Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory Networks (Bi-LSTM) is introduced to enhance the model's prediction capability on time series data. In addition, we utilize an optimized version of LSTM to enhance the prediction accuracy of the model further when facing different load scenarios. Experimental results show that the deep learning model proposed in this study improves prediction accuracies compared to traditional load prediction methods, and prediction errors are significantly reduced. This confirms the model's theoretical validity and provides practical technical support for cloud computing resource management and scheduling decisions in practical applications.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Management Strategy of Pure Electric Vehicle Based on Component Energy Consumption Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Pure electric vehicles use batteries as power sources. Since the power lithium battery pack has limited power, the whole vehicle energy must be reasonably optimized and managed to improve the vehicle range. Based on the MATLAB/Simulink software platform, a vehicle model for energy management of multiple energy-consuming components is established, and a mathematical model that takes into account the main energy-consuming components such as the electric motor, the battery, the air conditioning system, the driver's model, the lighting system, and the electric vacuum pump and electric steering booster pump is established. The optimal decentralized coordinated control strategy based on energy feedback is designed and proposed for each system model of the pure electric vehicle, and the corresponding distributed optimal control strategies are designed for different modules in the model. Finally, the numerical simulation model is utilized to verify the feasibility of the control strategy, and the control strategy is partially verified by the experimental vehicle platform. The road condition of NEDC, is selected in which all the proposed control strategies significantly reduce the battery SOC consumption and improve the range compared with no energy control strategy.

articleTitle: Facilitating Web Vulnerability Detection on Embedded Devices with Root Path Pruning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Taint analysis is an effective technique for vulnerability detection. Static taint analysis based on symbolic execution has shown promising results in the realm of web vulnerability detection on embedded devices. Nevertheless, the adoption of symbolic execution techniques for tainted propagation and constraint solving confronts the challenge of exploring myriad irrelevant paths, consequently leading to inefficiency. To address this issue, a novel approach is proposed for optimizing the efficiency of web vulnerability detection on embedded devices, based on root path pruning. This method involves analyzing the tainted propagation trajectories obtained through static taint analysis to extract path information that needs exploration within the function containing the tainted injection point. Subsequently, precise path pruning is performed in the first function where symbolic execution begins, i.e., the function containing the tainted injection point. This pruning eliminates exploration of irrelevant paths from the source, preventing their proliferation through function calls and thereby reducing the abundance of unrelated paths that need to be explored through symbolic execution. Ultimately, this approach enhances efficiency by significantly reducing the need for exploration of irrelevant paths. The experimental results indicate that applying this method to existing embedded device web vulnerability detection tools can effectively enhance efficiency without any side effects.

articleTitle: Hypertension Identification and Classification Based on Temporal Convolutional Networks and Support Vector Machines
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Hypertension, one of the most common cardiovascular diseases, may not have obvious symptoms in its early stages, making it difficult to detect through simple blood pressure tests. A deep learning method using electrocardiogram signals as the source has been proposed for automatic feature extraction and classification of hypertension. Firstly, electrocardiogram is processed using methods such as wavelet decomposition to locate and calculate RR-intervals. Then, re-model and extract features from the RR interval data using a Temporal Convolutional Network combined a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory Network, with added attention mechanism. Finally, a Support Vector Machine classifier optimized by the Dung beetle optimizer is used for hypertension recognition and classification. Simulations using datasets from the PhysioNet database, including shareedb, nsrdb, and nsr2db, show that the model achieves an accuracy, recall rate, specificity, and precision of 93.8%, 96.4%, 88.9%, and 94.3% respectively, with an F1-score of 95.3%. This method can timely identify hypertension, reminding patients to control their blood pressure through effective treatment to avoid adverse consequences.

articleTitle: Cloud-Network Resource Perception and Modeling Technology Based on Software-Defined Computing First Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The Computing First Network (CFN) is a novel network paradigm that efficiently allocates and schedules computing force, storage resources, and network capacity across cloud, edge, and device domains. Leveraging the comprehensive network perspective offered by Software-Defined Networking (SDN) and precise assessment of distributed computing resources, this paper introduces an architecture known as Software-Defined Computing First Network (SD-CFN). This architecture forms the basis for modeling computing and network resources and designing a new representation of network topology. Ultimately, the proposed architecture and the novel network topology representation undergo comprehensive analysis and validation.

articleTitle: SCA-PointNet++: Fusion Spatial-Channel Attention for Point Cloud Extraction Network of Buildings in Outdoor Scenes
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The development of acquisition and generation techniques for 3D point clouds of large-scale outdoor scenes provides a prerequisite for subsequent digital twin analysis of the 3D world. However, due to the irregularity and complexity of 3D point cloud data, extracting buildings directly from large-scale point clouds is still full of challenges. In this paper, based on the introduction of Convolutional Attention Mechanism (CBAM) for PointNet++ network, and feature coding techniques, SCA-PointNet++ fusion channel-space attention point cloud extraction network for buildings in outdoor scenes is proposed. Enhanced local spatial feature saliency through local spatial location coding, channel-spatial attention mechanism to improve the learning ability of salient structures, and disparity pooling under the attention mechanism to improve the feature delivery efficiency and better point cloud segmentation are evaluated on the SensatUrban dataset. A comparative study with five established deep learning point cloud classification models confirms that our proposed SCA-PointN et++ achieves good performance in the task of classifying cloud buildings at outdoor site locations.

articleTitle: Maritime Ship Target Detection Based on Proved YOLOV7 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: A maritime target detection method based on improved YOLOv7 is proposed to address the problems of low accuracy and poor timeliness caused by the interference of the complex ocean environment and the variable scale of the target to be measured. Firstly, a global context module (GC-model) is introduced in the backbone part to improve the localization accuracy for key feature information in complex situations. Secondly, an SA-BiFPN network structure is designed to replace the path aggregation network (PAN) structure to speed up the flow rate of feature information, and finally, VarifocalLoss is introduced to optimize the binary cross-entropy loss (BCELoss) to solve the problem of extreme imbalance between foreground and background classes in maritime target detection, and experiments show that the improved YOLOv7 has improved accuracy and recall by 5.8% and 3.3%, respectively, and AP50 by 5.4% compared with the original YOLOv7, which can effectively improve the recognition accuracy of objects under complex sea surfacet.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning and Dempster-Shafer Theory: A Unified Approach to Imbalanced Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Imbalanced classification issues arise when there's a significant disparity in the distribution of samples among different classes within the training dataset. This class imbalance presents a substantial hurdle for machine learning models, often causing bias towards the majority class and consequently leading to subpar performance on minority classes. Traditional strategies for tackling imbalanced classification encompass data resampling methods like oversampling or undersampling, cost-sensitive learning, and ensemble techniques. However, these approaches may not consistently yield satisfactory outcomes as they can overlook crucial interclass dependencies and relationships. In recent years, Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) has emerged as a promising avenue for addressing imbalanced classification challenges. DRL marries deep neural networks with reinforcement learning algorithms, enabling the learning of effective strategies through interactions with the environment. This approach empowers the model to make more informed decisions by considering long-term rewards. In our proposal, Evidential DQN takes a distinctive route, harnessing evidence theory to model uncertainty and enhance prediction reliability. By integrating evidence computation into the Deep Q-Network (DQN), our model bolsters its capability to classify samples in imbalanced contexts. Simultaneously, it refines the partitioning of decision boundaries, ultimately resulting in improved classification outcomes.

articleTitle: Improvement of Multi-Mechanism PBFT Consensus Algorithm Based on Attribute-Based Encryption Grouping
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The PBFT consensus algorithm is widely used in consortium blockchains due to its good performance in Byzantine fault tolerance, but problems still exist in some aspects such as random election of master nodes, high communication overhead, and poor network scalability. Many researchers use node grouping to solve the above problems, but there are still some deficiencies in the credibility mechanism, grouping algorithm and consistency mechanism. To address the shortcomings of existing researches, this paper proposes a multi-mechanism PBFT consensus improvement algorithm based on attribute-based encryption grouping (ABE-MPBFT). Firstly, based on the nodes' positivity, honesty and computational ability, we design the credibility evaluation mechanism to establish the grouping criteria, then construct the credibility reward and penalty mechanism to update the nodes' grouping. Secondly, attribute sets are assigned to nodes, and node grouping is spontaneously realized using CP-ABE in the process of consensus message encryption and decryption transmission, which solves the problem of large computational overhead and reuse of traditional grouping algorithms. According to different node properties of inter-group and intra-group, we design two-phase, three-phase and four-phase consistency mechanisms for each group to further reduce the communication overhead. Finally, it is proved through experiments that this algorithm can effectively reduce the number of communication, and improve consensus delay and TPS.

articleTitle: DM-ConvTNet: An Effective Hybrid Model for Rice Disease Recognition in Challenging Field Backgrounds
